notes.title: Server Maintenance - Wednesday, September 24
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2a6c397fa677367a01c167cf9ff8ad1dd6b7acbd.png[/img]

[b]WHAT:[/b] Server Maintenance (Matchmaking Servers)
[b]WHEN:[/b] Wednesday, September 24 @ 2:00pm PT / 5:00pm ET / 21:00 UTC ([url=https://www.timeanddate.com/countdown/generic?iso=20250924T14&p0=5154&msg=Maintenance+Starts+In%3A&font=serif&csz=1]Countdown[/url])
[b]EST. DOWNTIME:[/b] 1-2 HOURS

[h3][b]GAMES & PLATFORMS IMPACTED[/b][/h3][list][*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1017900/][i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] (Steam / Microsoft Store)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/813780/][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] (Steam / Microsoft Store / Xbox / PlayStation 5)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933110][i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] (Steam / Microsoft Store)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/][i]Age of Empires IV[/i][/url] (Steam / Microsoft Store / Xbox)
[/list]
[h3][b]OBJECTIVES[/b][/h3][list][*] Routine server updates and maintenance.[/list]
[h3][b]DETAILS[/b][/h3]This coming [b]Wednesday, September 24[/b], the platform team will be taking the multiplayer servers down for regular maintenance. Please note:

[quote][list][*] [b]Ranked matchmaking will disabled exactly one hour before the maintenance window to prevent disruption to newly-formed matches.[/b]

[*] [b]Any matches still in progress at the start of the maintenance window will be disrupted when it begins.[/b]

[*] [b]DURING THE MAINTENANCE WINDOW, YOU WILL STILL BE ABLE TO LAUNCH THE GAME, BUT WILL NOT BE ABLE TO MATCHMAKE OR ACCESS ANY ONLINE FEATURES.[/b]
[/list][/quote]
To prevent any interruptions, [b]we recommend wrapping up any games at least 10 minutes before the maintenance window.[/b] The downtime is expected to last between [b]1 and 2 hours[/b]. You can watch this thread with any changes to the schedule as they arise, as well as the all-clear when the maintenance is complete.

Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Announcing Age of Empires IV New Expansion – Pre-Order Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=JFGlln6vbx8;full][/previewyoutube]
At gamescom 2025, World’s Edge studio announced that [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] will take to new horizons with its release of a new expansion –[i] Age of Empires IV: Dynasties of the East[/i] – launching on November 4th. Pre-order [i]Dynasties of the East[/i] now for [b]15% off [/b]on Steam!

[b]Here’s everything you need to know ahead of launch on November 4th![/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Pre-Order the Newest DLC Now![/h2]
[i]Dynasties of the East[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam, with a limited-time 15% discount!
Coming November 4th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3067190/Age_of_Empires_IV_Dynasties_of_the_East/
[hr][/hr]

[h2]Everything Included with Dynasties of the East[/h2]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/db1a46360a71a097ebf20a0a3531d24cef42b928.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/801c39d60bfaff16e3e3038b1f0802f1cb371ec8.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3]4 New Variant Civilizations[/h3]
[b][i]Dynasties of the East[/i][/b] is a bold new expansion for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], introducing four variant civilizations, each with unique units, tech trees, and new strategies. Command the powerful [b]Golden Horde[/b], the ambitious [b]Macedonian Dynasty[/b], the tactical [b]Sengoku Daimyo[/b], and the versatile[b] Tughlaq Dynasty[/b]—each offering new ways to master the battlefield. 


[i]Want More? We’ve got you covered with civilization pages![/i]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][url=https://aoe.ms/golden-horde][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/8a4334c11ec8386118c88d5cfba1d75d76108705.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://aoe.ms/sengoku-daimyo][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7f42ae675440468294788043c99f858d45fd3a38.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][tr][td][url=https://aoe.ms/macedonian-dynasty][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/d408286dca601152a00d5fccc6c6788d93945d9e.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][url=https://aoe.ms/tughlaq-dynasty][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/582a56895cb3513584796d01d5d2e72fef536caf.jpg[/img][/url][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]More Maps and Biomes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/745f3c5cbd03eb2499f0d42e833f01c271f3616c.png[/img]
[i]Greek Islands Biome[/i]

Explore [b]six new biomes[/b], from tropical rainforests to mythic coastlines, and battle across [b]eight diverse maps[/b], ranging from focused and competitive to creative and chaotic. Whether you’re a seasoned tactician or returning to the battlefield to reclaim glory, [i]Dynasties of the East[/i] delivers the next great evolution in the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] experience.

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7ff7a07007c50410162c909ced20e2f0aa07454f.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/315cd94fab6d5da61ae65b447493704f5ec1073b.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/85acb928e6f60a1b9d5464df1af238f21e0e6204.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][i]Alpine Spring Biome[/i][/td][td][i]Temperate Fall Biome[/i][/td][td][i]Black Sand Beach Biome[/i][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2]The Crucible: All-New Gameplay Experience[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/5b0f4bb719a987ed1223c8e7bda61ce87607fc9b.png[/img]
This expansion also introduces [b]The Crucible[/b], an all-new singleplayer roguelite RTS experience built for replayability. Players face unpredictable enemy waves, randomized objectives, and unlockable upgrades. No two matches are the same, and each decision shapes the path forward.

Whether you’re defending your Wonder, unlocking powerful Perks or testing your endurance, The Crucible delivers a fresh twist on traditional [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] gameplay. 

[h2]Key Features at a Glance[/h2]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/10216a4ea7fc35305ca276c439199d56abc85b4f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7e4adf4694a1691f0a5277d2934b6f3ec1eca89e.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[list]
[*] 4 Variant Civilizations
[list][*] Golden Horde
[*] Macedonian Dynasty
[*] Sengoku Daimyo
[*] Tughlaq Dynasty[/list][*] 8 Maps and 6 Biomes
[*] The Crucible: an all-new singleplayer RTS experience with dynamic and unpredictable challenges
[/list]
[h2]Tune In[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/684d46b6734f55c5b0d8bd9624d14125a0b4dc16.jpg[/img]
Want to learn more about upcoming DLC [i]Dynasties of the East[/i]? Tune in to the Xbox @ gamescom Broadcast on Thursday the 21st at 9am PT to catch an exclusive look and interview with the devs.
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Pre-Order the Newest DLC Now![/h2]
[i]Dynasties of the East[/i] is available for pre-order now on Steam, with a limited-time 15% discount!
Coming November 4th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3067190/Age_of_Empires_IV_Dynasties_of_the_East/

notes.title: Celebrating Age in 2025 and What’s Still to Come This Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3764ab90b69179fe95efca71ebd861c072542482.jpg[/img]
It has been an incredibly busy 2025 so far for World’s Edge and the [i]Age of Empires[/i] and [i]Age of Mythology[/i] franchises, and as we cross the halfway mark together, we’d like to celebrate the amazing journey we’ve taken this year alongside our players. From record-breaking launches to community milestones and platform expansions, your passion and support have made the first half of the year nothing short of legendary.

Together, we’ve reached a new milestone: over 65 million players! This is more than just a number—it’s a testament to your passion, creativity, and support as a global community. Whether you’re commanding armies in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], growing your civilization in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], living the legend in [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i], or strategizing on the go with [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i], you are a part of something truly special.

With your incredible support for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, we’ve already released three remarkable expansions and brought both [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] and [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] to PS5. 

[h3]Let’s take a closer look at what you’ve helped bring to life so far in 2025:[/h3]

[list][*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/immortal-pillars-now-available/][i]Immortal Pillars[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] introduced an entirely new Chinese pantheon, the all-new Pillars of the Gods campaign, and seven new maps.
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new_dlc-age-iv-knights-of-cross-and-rose/][i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] delivered two new civilizations, the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster, as well as ten new maps for skirmish and multiplayer, and a new game mode: Historical Battles.
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new-dlc-available-now-the-three-kingdoms/][i]The Three Kingdoms[/i][/url] for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] brought five new civilizations: Shu, Wei, Wu, Jurchens, and Khitans, and three new campaigns exploring the epic Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
[*] PlayStation 5 releases: We created more opportunities for you to engage with the [i]Age[/i] franchise wherever you choose to play when we welcomed new players with the release of [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/pre-order-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-on-playstation-5/][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] and [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/early-access-for-age-of-mythology-retold-on-playstation-5-starts-today/][i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/url] on PlayStation 5.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4c95adeb7564096f2113926582720812792034fa.jpg[/img]

We didn’t just make history in-game this year—we made it in the real world, too! As the first-ever gaming partner of the legendary Louvre Museum, we joined forces to bring the epic story of the Mamluks (1250–1517) to life in a way never seen before. This groundbreaking collaboration is all about celebrating the golden age of medieval history and inspiring curiosity far beyond the screen.

With everything we packed into the first half of 2025, we still have so [b]much more[/b] to come, and the second half is shaping up to be even bigger! We’re so grateful you’re with us for every twist and turn, and we couldn’t do it without you.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]A New Pantheon Rises! Limited-Time 15% Off Pre-Order for Heavenly Spear – Launching September 30![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2adedfcadd9a5e143b36d6e28046f8cc6ffe765f.jpg[/img]
As part of the Xbox Showcase in June, we announced the next expansion for [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] will be [i]Heavenly Spear[/i]. For the first time in [i]Age of Mythology[/i] history, we’re bringing Japanese mythology to life! For the first time in [i]Age of Mythology[/i] history, we’re bringing Japanese mythology to life and invites you to immerse yourself in the legends, gods, and heroes of Japan – introducing a brand-new Japanese Pantheon, an epic 12-mission campaign, and mythic powers never before seen in the franchise.

To celebrate this milestone, we’re offering a limited-time 15% discount when you pre-order [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] before launch. This is your chance to be among the first to experience this vibrant new world and save!

[b]Remember, if you’ve purchased the Premium Edition of [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i], you’ll be able to access [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] at launch.[/b]

[hr][/hr]
Want to find out more about [i]Heavenly Spear[/i]? We’ve got you covered!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][/td][td][url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/pre-order-heavenly-spear-for-age-of-mythology-retold/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/b288483a3fc3fcda23e3e5b206efaae9ea3506ab.jpg[/img][/url][/td][td][/td][/tr][/table]
[hr][/hr]
We’re thrilled to share new screenshots from the expansion, including our heroic Yasuko and the formidable villain Magumo—both of whom captured your imagination during the Xbox Showcase.

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3ceb7f7e8a439e7e2d08b4b5991eced7a924609f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5778a56af69801a73f148538d2a9eb0a12f4ed63.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table][table equalcells=1 noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/eb3376277ded4689f63706de083f008969be359f.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/528b6a314eb2cc5b62bfbb631627fa8ca0c53520.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Don’t miss out—pre-order [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] now and be part of our most exciting adventure yet!
[hr][/hr]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2991180/Age_of_Mythology_Retold__Heavenly_Spear/
[hr][/hr]
If you’re coming to Gamescom, be sure to join us at the World’s Edge booth to be one of the first to play [i]Heavenly Spear[/i] and experience the wonder of the Japanese pantheon!

[h2]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition continues to grow![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4fa3fc3d986cf87474001ee29df911c5b6c78e50.jpg[/img]

This has already been a humongous year for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! In April, we released the game’s [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-update-141935/]biggest update yet[/url], including our largest balance pass, additional units for civilizations, new regional visuals for units and buildings, new maps available to all our players, and much more.

In May, we welcomed [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/available-now-age-of-empires-ii-definitive-edition-on-playstation-5/]new players on PlayStation 5[/url] and launched the fastest selling Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition expansion to date, [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/new-dlc-available-now-the-three-kingdoms/][i]The Three Kingdoms[/i][/url]!

The year isn’t over yet, and today we’re teasing our next expansion for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], coming later this year. While we can’t reveal the details at this stage, we can share a couple of images that chronicle this great upcoming adventure.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/43df71f901950de056bab21b6a11e3748ebf1cdc.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/21979a92c4f13bc61bf26224dfd3013b0e969d52.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5a6e5b420f24d0273dcd6ce4beb7f8500591ffc0.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Stay tuned for a more in-depth look very soon!

[h2]Knights of Cross and Rose led the charge in Spring 2025, and Fall will bring more battles and content for Age of Empires IV[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/2f794033c4f64f0503d1edc503af2536b8297adf.jpg[/img]

In April we launched [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], the second expansion for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] and one of the best-selling expansions ever for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise! We’ve been thrilled to hear your feedback, see your new strategies, and watch gameplay as you’ve marched into battle with the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster.

In February 2025, we revealed this year would bring two new expansions for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. With [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] already available, we are excited to share that the next big release will come in the Fall of 2025.

Our focus for content this year was to expand on existing concepts, as well as experiment with shorter and more repeatable experiences. While the Historical Battles included in [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] provided one avenue for shaking up our formula by fusing more traditional narrative-driven elements of a campaign mission with a scoring system and levels designed to promote more exploration, we’ve continued to push things even farther with a new game mode we’ll be unveiling with this next expansion. In fact, while there will be plenty of the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] gameplay you know and love to revel in, you might recognize core elements from other genres making their debut as well. We’re pretty sure you’ll like what you see, and there’s so much more to share!

While we aren’t ready to go into the exact details yet, we do hear rumblings that a previously mentioned event in Cologne later this summer would be a great moment to stay tuned to the [i]Age of Empires[/i] channels.

[h2]Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition is coming, play first at Gamescom[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e2181c0dd353081bc93000207ef8d1f9a5ba04ff.jpg[/img]

In October 2024 we launched [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] and millions of players around the world have been building cities, recruiting heroes and winning battles with their alliances.

Today we’re excited to announce that we’re bringing the title to PC. This new PC Edition brings rapid pacing combined with PC elements that players demand: optimized mouse control and settings, full keyboard navigation, refined UI, enhanced 4K visuals, and seamless Steam and Xbox Live integration.

We’ll have more details on the title soon including release date, but visitors to the [i]Age of Empires[/i] booth at Gamescom will be the first to get to play [i]Age of Empires Mobile: PC Edition[/i] and we can’t wait to see you.

[h2]Competitive Age Continues to Flourish in 2025![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/51cb7fa0dfefbcd1987efd427bab1639b91e0647.jpg[/img]

Players in the [i]Age of Empires[/i] Esports scene are competing harder than ever before, creating exhilarating moments for fans around the globe. With over $200,000 awarded to players in S-tier events alone so far in 2025, we still have many events and surprises upcoming in the second half of the year. Including a LAN event in Germany and China!
[list][*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] champion:
[list][*] Hera continued his dominance in the T90 Titans League 4, The Garrison, and Warlords IV.[/list]
[*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] champions:
[list][*] Beasty in the EGC Masters Winter.
[*] MarineLorD in The Elite Classic III.
[*] loueMT in the EGC Masters Summer.
[*] MarineLorD in the Masters of Steel.[/list]
[*] Congratulations to our S-tier [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] champions:
[list][*] TheMista in Clash of Immortals.
[*] Kvothhh in Mythic Wars.[/list][/list]

Thank you to our incredible and dedicated tournament organizers who turn these thrilling spectacles into reality, and to our devoted players who continue to master the titles of the [i]Age[/i] franchise.

For more information on upcoming [i]Age of Empires[/i] Esports events, please see our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar/]Events Calendar[/url] to watch along live and support your favorite players!

[hr][/hr]

This is only a sneak peek at what’s still to come for [i]Age of Empires[/i] and [i]Age of Mythology[/i]. We can’t wait to share more and hope it sparked your excitement for everything coming in the second half of the year.

The best way to stay informed on everything [i]Age[/i] is to follow our official channels below, we’ll be sharing more details as soon as we can. For now, please continue to send us your feedback, your thoughts and what you’d like to see next across our social channels, forums, Discord, and Steam.

Wololo!

notes.title: New Age of Empires 4 patch promises to fix DLC after mixed Steam reviews
notes.content:
Released in 2023, The Sultans Ascend DLC pack for Age of Empires 4 adds a new campaign and two new civilizations. It's a significant expansion for Relic and company's beloved strategy game, and well worth the price. Knights of Cross and Rose is arguably not so substantive. The latest AoE 4 DLC introduces two new armies, ten maps, and four historically based missions - but not a full campaign, and no extra civilizations. Costing the same as The Sultans Ascend, Knights of Cross and Rose has earned criticism from some AoE 4 players owing to a perceived shortage of fresh material. With Steam reviews now officially 'mixed,' Relic and fellow development teams Climax, World's Edge, and Forgotten Empires have shipped a new Age of Empires 4 patch in an effort to correct the course.

Read the rest of the story...

[quote][h2]DLC Spotlight: Knights of Cross and Rose[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/72d8eeded06fb0a8df605f3c39d4dd6edf54590a.png[/img]
We will be launching our Season Ten update alongside our newest expansion, [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i]! This DLC features new variant civilizations for the French and English, as well as a new game mode and ten maps. 

[h3]Variant Civilization: Knights Templar[/h3]
The Knights Templar are making their debut as a new variant civilization for the French. Founded with the goal to protect pilgrims on their way to the Holy Land, the Templars became renowned for their financial sophistication and defensive fortresses in the Levant. We aimed to highlight their cultural and military excellence through unique, highly flexible gameplay. 

The Knights Templar do not progress to the next age when a landmark is built, but rather age up with Town Centers. This allows them to select one of three [b]Templar Commanderies[/b] per age, each providing their own set of powerful unique units and features. For example, players can select the [b]Kingdom of Poland[/b] for a tanky Heavy Cavalry unit and a massive boost to Cavalry charge damage, or the [b]Knights Hospitaller[/b] for a new Man-At-Arms variant and a civilization-wide boost to economic unit heath and healing received. 

This variant civilization foregoes the French’s standard Trade Economy trait in favor of the new [b]Pilgrimage[/b] trait. Instead of relying on Traders for gold generation, the Knights Templar gain gold by sending Pilgrims to Sacred Sites. In addition to this, they also reveal all Sacred Sites at the start of the game, so be sure to use this extra intel to plan out your pilgrimages!  

This only scratches the surface of the many tricks the Knights Templar have up their sleeves, and we are beyond excited for [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] players to maximize their potential. The Knights Templar’s creative, game-bending playstyle not only shakes up established gameplay norms, but brings the rich history of one of France’s most renowned military orders to life. 

[h3]Variant Civilization: House of Lancaster [/h3]
Fearless combatants in the Wars of the Roses, the House of Lancaster established themselves as Europe’s most dominant military force after winning the famous battle of Agincourt against the French. The House of Lancaster variant civilization showcases their undeniable military capability while also providing a streamlined, intuitive gameplay experience. 

The House of Lancaster’s notorious prowess at range is well illustrated through their unique units. The variant civilization replaces the Longbowman with the all-new [b]Yeoman[/b] unit. Not only is the Yeoman stronger and more mobile than your average archer, they can also rain down a volley of arrows with their unique [b]Synchronized Shot[/b] ability. We all know it can be a delicate art balancing your army’s survivability with enough range to whittle down the enemy. However, you can have the best of both worlds with the House of Lancaster’s Earl’s Guard unit! This unique Man-At-Arms possesses the bulk and power you’d expect from a Heavy Infantry unit, but can also toss daggers at range to deal huge burst damage.  

In addition to its powerful military units, the House of Lancaster gains several new traits that help players amass a veritable horde of resources. The [b]Wool Industries[/b] trait grants players free sheep when a Town Center is built and allows villagers to gather from sheep faster. Additionally, players can construct several [b]Manors[/b] throughout the game, providing the House of Lancaster a consistent stream of gold for each one built. The Manor’s abilities only grow as new unique Technologies are unlocked.  

The House of Lancaster will provide a familiar, comfortable gameplay experience for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] players while also offering a bevy of unique traits to keep things fresh. We think this new variant civilization will be a favorite for new and old fans alike! 

[h3]Game Mode: Historical Battles [/h3]
In the [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] expansion, players can dive into four new single player Historical Battles. Unlike the more narrative-centric campaigns, these scenarios focus on key moments throughout the history of the Knights Templar and the House of Lancaster. By narrowing our scope to singular, larger-than-life battles, we are able to provide an even richer historical experience than [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] players have seen before!  

In contrast to previous game modes, players are scored and ranked based on their performance during each Historical Battle rather than solely on their ability to secure a victory. Each battle is filled with secrets and traps for players to uncover, which can significantly affect their final score. Players can explore the intricacies of each map and use their discoveries to improve future playthroughs. Historical Battles are designed to be more than a one-time experience – we want players to feel compelled to attempt them time and time again![/quote]
[quote][h2]Season Ten[/h2]
It’s time to flex your true strength. [b]Season Ten runs from April 8th to June 25th.[/b]

Our first event of the season, Clash of Champions, is an opportunity to show your excellence in all forms, whether it be your skills in archery or jousting on horseback. Dominate the competition and display your rewards proudly. 

Come join us in our first of several seasonal events, [b]Clash of Champions, in a celebration of competitive spirit from April 8 through April 28th. [/b]

notes.title: Age of Empires IV: Knights of Cross and Rose – Pre-Order Now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xJqje1CC2Q0;full][/previewyoutube]

Delve into the action of the next DLC for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] – [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i]! Experience rich, historically-inspired design across a variety of additional content, including a different design philosophy behind two new variant civilizations – the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster.

Command these iconic armies straight out of history, and forge your own destiny! Lead the Knights Templar in the Battle of Montgisard as they stave off Saladin’s forces, and ensure the House of Lancaster’s survival against the Yorkists after a calamitous defeat at Towton. [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] [b]launches on April 8th[/b] and [b]is available for pre-order now on Steam with a 15% discount![/b]

[i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] delivers new experiences to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] players with:
[list][*] [b]Two new Variant Civilizations[/b] that change gameplay like never before – Knights Templar (French variant) and House of Lancaster (English variant). 
[*] [b]New game mode:[/b] Historical Battles. Lead iconic armies in an action-packed battles inspired by history. Earn medals and test your strategic might in the optional Conqueror mode.  
[*] [b]Ten new maps[/b] on which to skirmish, battle and forge your way to victory.
[*] [b]New Achievements[/b] [/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144890

[h2]Variant Civilizations [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/0c4cd6b3a45c1d844307fc18c42c6eead663c229.jpg[/img]
We introduced [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-sultans-ascend-variant-civilizations-deep-dive/]Variant Civilizations to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] with [i]Sultans Ascend[/i].[/url] Since then, the team has pushed things even further to explore a broad range of history by highlighting specific moments in time. With the feedback from [i]Sultans Ascend[/i] in mind, we’ve applied a more direct “civilization treatment” and aimed for as high a level of authenticity as possible. We’ve added more content, more unique units, more upgrades and more abilities.

We’re excited to present two exciting new Variant Civilizations: the Knights Templar and the House of Lancaster.  

[h2]Knights Templar (French Variant)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/eee70b7c09ce5459693fda89a8b53fd99aeb986e.jpg[/img]
Command the indomitable Knights Templar with their valorous crusaders and blend of European military traditions, which brings a wide range of possible strengths

The Knights were a Military Order, bringing together individuals from a variety of nations. With a powerful unit roster, the Knights Templar’s unique recruitment system gives them a fun strategic edge.

With the real historic order, Templar Commanderies were established in almost every European Kingdom. In [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], we bring this historic system to life through the Commanderie Age Up system. Select one of three allies with each Age to receive a permanent bonus and unique unit. With a broad roster of unique units to choose from, you’ll need to consider both your short and long-term strategy!

The Knights Templar’s unique keep, the Fortress, will play a key strategic role in their overall gameplay.

We can’t wait to see how things play out when you take command of this legendary Military Order when [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] launches on April 8th.

[h2]House of Lancaster (English Variant) [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/ca2045528d043e64abb6ba757073ed5fad72baed.jpg[/img]
Marshal the resolute forces of the House of Lancaster, stepping into the turmoil of England’s War of the Roses. Possessing unparalleled tactics; the House of Lancaster utilizes their thriving economy to acquire technological advances that were new to European knowledge at the time.  

The House of Lancaster were key players in two of the most influential wars which shaped European medieval history; the War of the Roses and the Hundred Years War. The Lancasters forged a reputation for their incomparable ranged battlefield tactics and an unyielding support for the arts and sciences.  

These historical influences inspired much of the gameplay you’ll see when playing the House of Lancaster in [i]Knights of the Cross and Rose[/i]. The House of Lancaster comes armed with not only a powerful ability called Synchronized Shot – a wide-ranging volley shot – but they’re also bolstered by the Manor, a unique building which generates resources. 

The House of Lancaster serve as a departure from their English-based civilization while still providing an intuitive playstyle which leans towards defensive strategies, allowing players to add a fresh take on play.  

[h2]Historical Battles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/0fa999166549a3504371df3f2957979066bb116b.jpg[/img]
Live the legacy of these iconic armies in a new single-player action-packed game mode: Historical Battles – arriving with [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] on April 8th.  

This new game mode deviates from the traditional narrative-focused campaign by focusing in on select moments in history that were pivotal for the Knights Templar and the House of Lancaster. With gameplay enriching cinematics and voice-acting, their standalone mission format allows real history to inspire a challenging set of objectives which put the power to defy history in your hands.  

Players are scored and ranked by their performance through a medal system. As you strive for victory and a score you can take pride in, you’ll find secrets, traps, and more hidden in the maps, promoting exploration. The result is a gameplay experience that feels like a puzzle and allows for replayability as you search to discover every element that could ensure your victory and reach the top medal category. For those seeking a true challenge, unlock Conqueror mode based on decisions made during the mission.  

Rally the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster in missions inspired by iconic historical confrontations. Lead the Knights Templar in the Battle of Montgisard as they stave off Saladin’s forces. Ensure the House of Lancaster’s survival against the Yorkists after a calamitous defeat at Towton. 

[h2]New Maps[/h2]
The shape of the battlefield is a truly dynamic part of your campaign for victory. With [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], we’re adding ten new maps. Here’s a preview:

notes.title: Dive Into the Action of Age of Empires IV: Knights of Cross and Rose
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/72d8eeded06fb0a8df605f3c39d4dd6edf54590a.png[/img]
Prepare to embark on an epic journey with [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], the newest [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] DLC, set to release this spring! While we’re still putting the finishing touches on this exciting release, we wanted to pull back the curtain and provide an overview of what you can expect from [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i].  

Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or newer to the series, this DLC delivers rich, historically-inspired content that can be enjoyed across a variety of modes, including two variant civilizations – the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster, for which the DLC is named. Get a fresh look into the opportunities afforded with variant civilizations, allowing us to deeply expand upon the concept.

[h2]Key Features to Look Forward to: [/h2]
[list][*] Two New Variant Civilizations: Knights Templar and House of Lancaster 
[*] 10 New Maps for Skirmish and Multiplayer 
[*] New Game Mode: Historical Battles [/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Live the Legacy – Wishlist Now![/h3]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] – [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] is coming this spring!

Wishlist today on Steam, and keep your eyes posted on our official channels for more information leading into our pre-order phase, which is starting very soon on all platforms and will include a 15% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144890/Age_of_Empires_IV_Knights_of_Cross_and_Rose/

[hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Age-ing Up Variant Civilizations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/21851935b3d891cf2a5f569e2b97b3add4ba396e.jpg[/img]
While base civilizations like the English and French allow us to explore a broad range of human history, variant civilizations provide a unique opportunity to dive deep into specific moments in time and unearth the stories within. This is a design philosophy the team believes in, and with [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], the team was able to expand upon this concept with feedback from the community fresh in mind.  

One thing we heard loud and clear from players is the importance of staying true to history (as much as possible!) while still presenting fun gameplay mechanics – even with variant civilizations. With that in mind, we’ve given the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster a more direct “civilization treatment,” drawing inspiration from the moments in time these well-known groups inhabited and aiming for a high level of authenticity as much as possible.  

Not only are we leaning more into history as our compass when it comes to overall design, but we’re also packing in [i]more content[/i]. These variants bring with them even more unique units, upgrades and abilities to ensure they stand out from their base civilization in meaningful ways. In the case of the Knights Templar, there are no shared traits, bonuses, units or upgrades between them and the French civilization.[/quote]  
[quote][h2]The Knights Templar[/h2]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/cb79c843a3857fe338b1ac4647557b5fb64391ad.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/9316151d3448ecbaa691c95c46f6fb9b6718c056.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
The Knights Templar, while a well-known historical group, were neither a state nor kingdom. As a Military Order, they were comprised of individuals from a variety of nations, this unique situation allowed our team some degree of creative freedom when exploring how to best represent the Knights Templar in gameplay. While their unit roster is powerful, it’s the Knights Templar’s unique recruitment system that we believe will give them a fun strategic edge.  

Historically, Templar Commanderies were established in nearly every European Kingdom acting as a source of power and prestige for the Order. With [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i], this system is brought to life with the Commanderie Age Up system, in which you can select one of three allies with each Age to receive a permanent bonus and unique unit. Did we mention yet that Knights Templar have a lot of unique units? 

Furthermore, the Templars built [i]a lot[/i] (like a lot a lot) of Castles, Fortresses and various fortifications around Europe and the Levant. Thus, the Fortress, their unique keep, plays a key strategic role in their overall gameplay.[/quote] 
[quote][h2]House of Lancaster[/h2]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/12a318ef6c64bc13cb1bfaad6a8745d335f914e3.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/5fc5644db5d157bb56ae82d7a3244ee044525f64.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
The House of Lancaster were key players in two of the most formative wars in European medieval history: the War of the Roses and the Hundred Years War. The Lancasters were known for their unparalleled ranged tactics on the battlefield and an unyielding patronage of the arts and sciences.  

These historical elements inspired much of the gameplay when bringing the House of Lancaster variant civilization to life in this upcoming DLC. Not only does this variant civilization come equipped with a powerful ability called Synchronized Shot, which allows for a wide-ranging volley shot, but they’re also bolstered by the Manor, a unique building that generates resources. 

While the Knights Templar provide several sleek and wholly new gameplay options, the House of Lancaster serves as a departure from their English base civilization while still providing a generally intuitive playstyle that leans toward defensive strategies.[/quote] 
[quote][h2]Historical Battles[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/d33006f878bd16086b42c3dd68764575625bdc36.jpg[/img]
The new singleplayer mode, Historical Battles, deviates from the traditional narrative-focused campaign by narrowing in on select moments in history notable to the Knights Templar and House of Lancaster. While these Historical Battles aim to enrich the gameplay experience with elements common to campaign – including storybook-style cinematics and voice acting – their vignette quality (as standalone missions) allowed us to take real history as inspiration for a challenging set of objectives that, in some cases, put the power to defy history into the player’s hands. Some of these battles start in desperate situations that were historical defeats for the armies you’ll command, such as the Siege of Safed. This particular setup begs the question: With your wits and cunning, can you hold back the might of Baibar’s army that defeated the Knights Templar? 

A core element of these battles is that players are scored and ranked by their performance through an associated medal system, meaning we had to take a fundamentally different approach to the mission design. In the classic campaign format, missions are more linear with a singular focus on describing the actual event.  With Historical Battles, we have filled the maps with secrets, traps and more to promote exploration. This leads to the battles being puzzle-like in nature, which means that it’s not a “play once and be done with it” experience, but instead a mode that challenges you to optimize your play over repeated attempts. Players looking for an additional level of challenge have the option of unlocking Conqueror mode based on decisions made during the mission.  

We expect this style of content to resonate with a broader audience as it melds aspects of narrative common to campaigns with the replayability and strategic opportunities of skirmish. We’re looking forward to hearing what you think of this approach to singleplayer modes![/quote]

[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] – [i]Knights of Cross and Rose[/i] is coming this spring!

Wishlist today on Steam, and keep your eyes posted on our official channels for more information leading into our pre-order phase, which is starting very soon on all platforms and will include a 15% discount.

[h3]New Event![/h3]
This event is full of gifts to celebrate the Season! We have many challenges and rewards to customize your profile to match the season of giving. As well as a brand-new game mode filled with gifts to get you those victories! Keep your eyes on the battlefield and see how many gifts you can find.

notes.content:

While we’re still planning for a slightly larger patch before the end of the year, we wanted to roll out a few pointed fixes earlier based on your feedback. Today’s minor patch is focused on stability, Multiplayer Pause adjustments, and some additional early balance tuning in response to player input regarding the changes to Siege. 

Keep an eye out for our next patch, and in the meantime, be careful when there’s a Full Moon!

[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Patch 12.0.2246◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h3]Multiplayer Pause Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Based on your feedback, we’ve brought the period of required pause time for a player’s first pause back down from 60 to 30 seconds. We’ve also limited each player to only 3 pauses instead of 5. Let us know how we can continue to tune these values to ensure a fair but effective match! 
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to become stuck in the Multiplayer Pause menu after the match completed. [/list]
[h3]General Changes and Fixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed two crashes related to Full Moon mode, including one that could occur when werewolves spawn in Team games.  
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when using projectiles.  [/list]
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list][*] Silk Bowstrings range improvement for Archers reduced from 2 to 1.5.
[*] Silk Bowstrings range improvement for Mounted Archers reduced from 1 to .75.
[*] Mangonel bonus damage vs ranged increased from 8 to 10.
[*] Increase Mangonel and Nest of Bees range armor increased from 80 to 85%.
[*] Ribauldequin health reduced from 225 to 215.
[*] Ribauldequin Melee armor reduced from 15 to 10.[/list]

[h3]Updates Since the Public Update Preview[/h3]
Thanks to everyone for the fantastic PUP participation this September! We’ve heard your feedback that some siege weapons weren’t impactful enough and that left ranged units feeling too strong, and many other things. To address these concerns, we’ve made changes to ranged unit counters, siege, and university upgrades. There are too many changes from the PUP to list here, but here are some balance highlights:
[list][*] Horseman-type and Man-at-Arm-type units have increased ranged armor in the Imperial Age.
[*] Mangonels and Nest of Bees are now more resistant to ranged damage and Mangonels will retain some projectile tracking.
[*] The Silk Bowstrings technology is now more expensive.
[*] Elite Army Tactics now also improves bonus damage in addition to base damage.
[*] And many more![/list]
[h3]New Feature: Multiplayer Pause[/h3]
It’s now possible to pause the game during a multiplayer match. This option is on by default in Quickmatch and Ranked and can be enabled (or disabled) by the lobby host in custom matches.

Any player may pause at any time, but each player has a limit of five (5) pauses per match. During only the first pause for each player, a minimum duration of 60 seconds must pass before any other players may un-pause. The player who paused the game can un-pause at any time. Subsequent pauses by the same player may be un-paused at any time by any player.

Your remaining pauses will display on the pause screen. While inputs are not available during the pause, it’s still possible to chat.[/quote]

notes.title: Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado Starting October 3rd!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/925972daacc373983a5293ad6b32d87b89bb9d4c.jpg[/img]
The Red Bull Wololo tournament is [b]back[/b] with [b]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado starting tomorrow, October 3rd at 7:00 am PT (10am ET / 14:00 UTC)![/b] New legends will soon be forged through the fires of competition at Castillo de Almodóvar del Río in Spain – summoning the fiercest [i]Age of Empires[/i] champions to challenge the reigning kings of the castle for their crown and [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i]‘s first heroes!

[h2]What, When, Where, and How Can I Watch?[/h2]
Fearless contenders will join us for the main event starting on [b]October 3rd[/b] and culminate with four champions proudly taking their new thrones on[b] October 5th and 6th[/b].

Plus, with over twenty-five years of legendary battles in the Age of Empires franchise, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will comprise of four titles in which competitors will be able to prove themselves worthy:

[h3][i]Age of Empires[/i] – Played using [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] – [i]Return of Rome[/i][/h3]
October 6

[h3][i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i][/h3]
October 3, 4, 5, 6

[h3][i]Age of Empires IV[/i][/h3]
October 5

notes.title: Announcing Our New Public Esports Tournament Calendar!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/5dddc34dfc6a4ae99570122f0d3dadc984554ebd.jpg[/img]
We’re thrilled to announce a new and exciting feature for our community—starting today, the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is live! Whether you’re a competitor or a fan, this calendar is your place for staying up to date with every exciting event in our competitive gaming scene.

Access the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar]here[/url]!

[h2]Why We’re Introducing the Public Tournament Calendar[/h2]
As the esports scene continues to grow, we’ve noticed the demand for a centralized place where all tournament schedules are readily available and shared well in advance. We understand that keeping track of multiple events across multiple platforms can be overwhelming.

That’s why we’re making it easier for everyone to stay in the loop – whether you’re a seasoned pro or a dedicated fan.

[h2]What does the calendar include?[/h2]
The calendar will include World’s Edge sponsored tournaments for:
[list][*] [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
Be aware that some of the information displayed in the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i] is incomplete right now, to let the tournament host share more information with you at their own pace. All of the information displays what we can share at this moment and is [u][b]subject to change[/b][/u].

[h2]Stay Connected![/h2]
With the launch of this new feature, we’re taking another step towards fostering a more connected and informed esports community. Whether you’re a competitor looking to plan your next big challenge or a fan eager to follow your favorite player or teams, this calendar will be your go-to source for all things esports.

We’re incredibly excited to roll this out and make esports even more accessible. Stay tuned for further updates and new features that will make following and participating in the esports scene easier than ever!

See you at the tournaments!
[hr][/hr]

Want a glimpse into all the upcoming World’s Edge sponsored esports tournaments? Have a look at the the [i]Public Esports Tournament Calendar[/i]!

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/eventscalendar][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/2e85f1b1d26958f4a2b849cf6f19e650db906ebc.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Get a Sneak Peek of Age of Empires IV Season Nine with the PUP!
notes.content:
The [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Season Nine Public Update Preview (PUP) is set to run [b]from Tuesday, September 17, through Tuesday, September 24, at 9 a.m. PT![/b] Season Nine is shaping up to be one of our most ambitious gameplay updates to date. With far-reaching changes across several systems impacting every civilization in every game, we are bringing this PUP to you early in the hopes that we can [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/11/]gather meaningful feedback[/url][/b] as we continue to work on the update. 

Feedback at this stage is critical, as it will allow us to further hone balance, features and bug fixes prior to the official release of Season Nine. Many changes are experimental and may be adjusted as we gather data from the PUP, as well as some features and fixes already planned for Season Nine may not be present in this build. We’ll be considering your feedback not only as we continue the development of our Season Nine Update, but also as we consider mid-season patches. 

Finally, note that this is a preview build of an upcoming update to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Some features in this preview are not yet final.

[h3]How to participate in PUP on September 17th[/h3]

PUP Release Notes will be made available in the Steam Forums! Please note that you will need to be logged in with a Steam account that owns [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] to view. 
  
[b]To get started with the PUP build, owners on Steam can download the [i]Age IV[/i] PUP by following the instructions below:  [/b]
[olist][*] Navigate to your Steam library and right click on [b][i]Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition[/i][/b].
[*] Select [b]Properties…[/b] at the bottom of the menu.
[*] Select the [b]BETAS[/b] tab on the left.
[*] In the [b]Select the beta…[/b] dropdown menu, select [b]future_live[/b].
[*] The build will begin downloading—once complete, you are ready to play!
[/olist]
[quote][b]Note:[/b]
[list]
[*] Replays in the PUP build are not compatible with the retail version.
[*] Players in the PUP version will only be able to match with those also on the PUP build.
[*] To revert back to retail, simply change your beta branch (step 4 above) back to “None.” [/list][/quote]

This update features a rework to how the Rus accrue bounty. Previously, Rus gained bounty upon defeating huntable animals and wolves. This led to a race at the start of every game where both players engaged in a minigame to see who could find and defeat the most hunt. With this new update, Rus gains bounty over time while gathering food from animals, so both players should have more time to vie for control over the hunt on the map.

Previously, a player had to right click on a deer, then shift click to the town center and repeat that process for every single deer to make use of the technology. Now, a player can simply right click on a deer once with the technology researched and the scout will bring the deer back to the Capital TC (default) or a drop-off location of your choice. notes.title: Red Bull Wololo Is Back in 2024!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=A5n8EWTH6JQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The Red Bull Wololo tournament is [b]back[/b] in 2024 with [b]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/b] – when new legends will soon be forged through the fires of competition. Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will take place at Castillo de Almodóvar del Río in Spain – summoning the fiercest Age of Empires champions to challenge the reigning kings of the castle for their crown.

All are welcome to test their mettle – from seasoned veterans to those who wish to try their luck in a tournament for the very first time.

Plus, with over twenty-five years of legendary battles in the Age of Empires franchise, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will comprise of four titles in which competitors will be able to prove themselves worthy:
[list][*] [i]Age of Empires[/i] – Played using [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Return of Rome[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i][/list]
[b]This year, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will also tread the land of gods, legends and mythical beings in the first-ever competition in [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i].[/b]

[b]The qualification trials will soon commence[/b], allowing fearless contenders the chance to enter through the mighty castle gates at Castillo de Almodóvar del Río. Those who succeed will join us for the main event starting on [b]October 3rd[/b]! Days of fierce battles will end with four champions proudly taking their new thrones on [b]October 6th[/b].

You’ll be guided through the spectacle by the most beloved faces in the community, and you can catch the main event live on the Red Bull Gaming [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8VddvuHJzIj__Ud0rY2_ww]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/redbull/videos]Twitch[/url] channels. Whether you plan to witness the showdown from home or from the castle grounds, there will be plenty of action and activities for fans to enjoy.

Read the full announcement from [url=https://www.redbull.com/int-en/events/red-bull-wololo-el-reinado]Red Bull here[/url].
[quote][h2]Looking Back at Red Bull Wololo[/h2]
History trembles with the weight of legendary battles won and lost since the very first Red Bull Wololo tournament in 2020. Let us take a glance back through the ages and see how it all began.

[i]Spoilers below from the past Red Bull Wololo Tournaments![/i]

[h3]The First One[/h3]
[previewyoutube=8JWWUuMTnpo;full][/previewyoutube]
From the first spark of Red Bull Wololo, it was evident that we were witnessing something unique. The tournament was one of the first of its kind to utilise the newly added “Empire Wars” game mode, which allowed for more fast-paced and thrilling games, captivating audiences worldwide. With a prize pool of over $22,000.00, the competition was fierce. After an exhilarating grand final between TheViper and Mr_Yo, the first-ever Red Bull Wololo champion Mr_Yo was crowned.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo II[/h3]
[previewyoutube=C_TwCo4azhw;full][/previewyoutube]
It wasn’t long before the flames were reignited and Red Bull Wololo II was announced, but this time, the stakes were higher than ever with $30,000.00 on the line. The tournament proved that anything was possible – expectations and player seeding meant nothing in the level of competition we were witnessing. The games were sharper, the show was greater, and the competition was blazing with two new finalists. Liereyy and Hera both met in the grand final after fighting through the many challengers on their path, before ultimately Liereyy was crowned as the champion of Red Bull Wololo II.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo III[/h3]
[previewyoutube=R_lD3tnlhaE;full][/previewyoutube]
With Red Bull Wololo III, we saw the tournament format evolve. The thrill of group stages and nail-biting eliminations pushed the players to their limits. In an unforgettable final between DauT and Liereyy, expectations were deified and DauT snatched victory from one of the most highly-regarded players in [i]Age of Empires[/i].

[h3]Red Bull Wololo IV[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Z2JrGmekTQU;full][/previewyoutube]
Red Bull Wololo IV embraced the epic Viking spirit with a diverse set of themed maps; players were transported to a world of longships and brutal raids. Sixteen entered the fray, but only one could reign supreme. Yet, through the chaos, Hera and Liereyy met again. As the dust settled, through their undeniable dominance the Red Bull Wololo throne was reclaimed by Liereyy.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo: Enthrone[/h3]
[previewyoutube=2u3HupyXyKQ;full][/previewyoutube]
History changed forever with Red Bull Wololo: Enthrone, the fifth iteration of the event. The legendary Heidelberg Castle became the battleground for this breathtaking tournament. The Red Bull Wololo had outgrown its online roots and became a spectacle with players battling against each other face-to-face, in the confines of the castle walls. This was where TheViper challenged Liereyy for his crown, and after uncontested strategic brilliance, TheViper ascended, becoming our Red Bull Wololo champion.

[h3]Red Bull Wololo: Legacy[/h3]
[previewyoutube=c3Rztv3tlx0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=kskioX7oLX0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=8tVnLXrG-D4;full][/previewyoutube]
In 2022, another siege was on the horizon. Red Bull Wololo: Legacy, the sixth iteration. In a celebration of multiple games in the franchise, we witnessed a display of dominance across several titles, once more, in the grand Castle of Heidelberg. The roar of a first-ever live audience fueling the players of [i]Age of Empires[/i], [i]II[/i], and [i]IV[/i]. Chim Sẻ Đi Nắng, TaToH, and MarineLord, each a titan of their chosen title, emerged victorious.[/quote]
We hope you enjoyed this quick recap of past Red Bull Wololo events. You’ll be able to watch the upcoming Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado on the Red Bull Gaming [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC8VddvuHJzIj__Ud0rY2_ww]YouTube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/redbull/videos]Twitch[/url] channels. We hope to see you there!

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-seven-update-10-0-576/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Update 10.0.576◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Season Seven Update[/h2]
[quote][h3]New! Spring Tournaments Event[/h3]
Spring is here at last and what better time for a seasonal event? Prepare to login [b]May 21 at 10:00 AM PT (1:00 PM ET / 17:00 UTC)[/b] through [b]June 18 at 10:00 AM PT (1:00 PM ET / 17:00 UTC)[/b] for the Spring Tournaments rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/73f162cb3b2f0c61c1efc18c62b0eef315beba41.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/db45ef8c48f9a73d5a866d36d36a43718261d5a2.png[/img]
[h3]Login Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/e42d19ead40c0f265e227a4c793839f4f3c3f456.png[/img]
[/quote]
[quote][h3]Ranked Season Seven[/h3]
To arms! Ranked play kicks off for [b]Season Seven on March 19 at 12:00 pm PT (3:00 pm PT / 20:00 UTC)![/b] Age up through the ranks and earn rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/9d03cd55c1f930ae236168982caac93a9a3a554e.jpg[/img][/quote]
[quote][h4]Map Pool Rotation[/h4]
Season Seven brings another refresh on both map pools. This rotation gives some maps a much-needed break while we reintroduce maps that are excited to meet the new civilizations. High View, Lipany, and Danube River return to Solo Ranked while Prairie and Lipany return to Team Ranked.

See you on the ladder!

[b]1v1 Ranked Map Pool [/b]
[list]
[*] Dry Arabia
[*] Cliffside
[*] Rocky River
[*] Forts
[*] Gorge
[*] High View
[*] Danube River
[*] Lipany
[*] Four Lakes
[/list][b]New Team Ranked Map Pool[/b]
[list]
[*] Dry Arabia 
[*] Cliffside 
[*] Rocky River 
[*] Prairie 
[*] Gorge 
[*] Hill and Dale 
[*] Lipany 
[*] Migration 
[*] Waterholes 
[/list][/quote][/quote]
[quote][quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/69b1e33a6a7d18d031e01482255a19952084757d.png[/img]
[h3]Cross-Play is Now Available on PC and Console[/h3]
You can join your console and PC friends and adversaries on the battlefield with cross-play!

[h3]Team Ranked is Now Available on Console[/h3]
You can now jump into Team Ranked mode on console![/quote]
[quote][h3]Condensed Victory Objectives[/h3]
We’ve created an alternate version of win conditions that take up as little screen space as possible, these are enabled by default and can be changed back in the game UI options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/dca40162a4b638f82d583eddcd0f5a1e5da0f627.png[/img][/quote]
[quote][h3]Quick Match Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Nomad Game Mode was added as a new option and comes with several improvements. 
[*] A new Free for All option has been added, allowing you to queue for 8 Player free for all matches. 
[list]
[*] Quick match Free for All matches are played using the new “Dominion” win condition.[/list][/list][h4]A Note on Leaderboards and Hidden Elo[/h4]
Free For All will have a new leaderboard and track your hidden Elo separately, this means that matchmaking will result in more balanced games over time. In FFA mode, the winner is the only player to gain Elo and all other players lose Elo based on an even split equal to the amount of Elo that the winner gains.

Additionally, Nomad mode will share a leaderboard with Standard Mode. This means that when you queue for Nomad for the first time, you’ll be more likely to be matched with players close to your skill level.[/quote]
[quote][h3]Nomad Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Starting Villagers increased from 3 to 5.
[*] Villagers’ starting distance increased.
[*] Holy Roman Empire Prelate, Zhu Xi’s Legacy Official, and Mongols Ger are granted upon Town Center construction and not at the start of the match.
[*] English Villager bows and Chinese Villager build speed bonus are deactivated at the start of the game, reactivated upon Town Center construction.
[*] Jeanne d’Arc Civilization starts with 3 Villagers plus Jeanne d’Arc.
[*] Order of the Dragon Civilization starts with 4 Villagers.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h3]New “Dominion” Win Condition[/h3]
[list][*] Enabled/disabled in custom games via the Game Mode Win Conditions section (disabled by default).
[*] Compatible with Standard, Empire Wars, and Nomad Game Modes as well as all other win condition types.
[*] Players start with a Monarch that must be protected at all costs, losing a Monarch leads to the instant elimination of the owning player.
[list][*] Eliminating an enemy Monarch grants +50 maximum population.
[*] If a player is eliminated by Landmark victory, their Monarch remains on the field. Eliminating a neutral Monarch continues to grant +50 maximum population.[/list]
[*] Monarchs have two primary abilities:
[list][*] Sprint: Temporarily move faster.
[*] Treason: Reveal the location of enemy Monarchs and ping them on the minimap.[/list]
[*] Monarchs are visible on the minimap with a crown icon.
[*] AI players will garrison their Monarch into a safe building.
[*] When loading into a game with no other players or AI, the Dominion win condition will automatically deactivate and not spawn a Monarch at the start.[/list][/quote]
[quote][h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Walls under construction can now be converted into gates via an ability on the placed blueprint. Conversion to a gate can happen at any time before the wall section is finished construction, after which it is no longer possible to convert directly, and a Villager must be used. The cost of the conversion is the difference between the cost of the wall and gate. 
[*] When ungarrisoning from a building, units will exit the building from the location closest to the rally point direction.[/list][/quote][/quote]

notes.title: New Year, New Age Show – the Rundown
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/5db528d48be80a0b766b4ac2be96d2f12325a90d.jpg[/img]
We on the [i]Age of Empires[/i] team want to say a huge thank you to our 50 million players around the world. 2023 was a huge year for our games and our community. We wanted to share a look at what there is to look forward to in 2024, and we’ve just wrapped our New Year, New Age show which did just that. If you watched, thank you for joining us! If you weren’t able to join us live, or you just want a reminder of all the things we covered, here’s a rundown of what’s coming this year.

[list][*] [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] new DLC – Victors and Vanquished – coming March 14th
[*] [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] coming to Xbox and PC in 2024
[*] [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] first look
[*] New Year, New Age Sale with games and DLC up to 50% off
[*] [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] update and Season 7 coming early Spring
[*] New Year, New Age login reward for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] available now
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] free to play now! New DLC coming end of 2024
[*] Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado coming later this year[/list]
[h1]New DLC for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/h1]
[h3][i]Victors and Vanquished coming March 14th: Pre-Order Now![/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/6d19fed5f4ec0e08e3add9da58270ee59e884d6d.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] had a landmark year in 2023 with the addition of the [i]Return of Rome[/i] and [i]The Mountain Royals[/i] expansions. More than four years after launch, the game continues to grow. Telling more stories from the world’s rich history as well as bringing more civilizations to play.

The next chapter for [i]Age of Empires II: DE[/i] will be the single player focused DLC [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i], [b]coming March 14th[/b]. Introduced in today’s show by its Creator, Ramsey Abdulrahim, this DLC will be like no other we’ve made before for [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] features 19 epic scenarios. Your strategy and choices will decide your fate: will you emerge as the ultimate victor, or fall as the vanquished? You’ll play as Ragnar Lothbrok, Oda Nobunaga, Charlemagne and more. Each scenario features professional voice acting, new music, achievement and the quality you’d expect from an official [i]Age of Empires[/i] scenario. 

[b]Pre-Order Now![/b]
[i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] will be launching soon, and you can pre-order today and receive a 15% discount! [i]Victors and Vanquished[/i] [b]comes to Steam on March 14th 2024[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2805510/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Victors_and_Vanquished/?beta=1

[previewyoutube=2E721-vptOo;full]https://youtu.be/2E721-vptOo[/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Mythology: Retold[/h1]
[h3]Coming to Xbox and PC in 2024 – Wishlist Now![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7213894171ecbe692cda8392aa8f18e08ccabc14.png[/img]
[i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] is another title that got its debut at our 25th anniversary. Since then, we’ve continued to develop this exciting reimagining of fan favorite [i]Age of Mythology[/i].

Today Art Director Melinda Rose gave players worldwide their first look at [i]Retold[/i] via three in-game units, brought to life through amazing AR technology. Showcasing Medusa, Pegasus and Cerberus from the Greek pantheon, Melinda took us through how each unit has been updated, given completely new art and even had gameplay tweaks that will intensify their strengths and unique powers making them even more important in your strategy. They will be stronger, faster, bigger and bolder.

We are also beyond thrilled to announce that players do not have long to wait. [i]Age of Mythology: Retold[/i] is coming to Steam in 2024 and is available to wishlist now!

If you want more information about what we showed today, be sure to follow the [i]Age of Mythology[/i] social channels and visit [url=http://www.ageofempires.com/]www.ageofempires.com[/url].

[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100086916204891][i]Age of Mythology[/i] on Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/ageofmythgame][i]Age of Mythology[/i] on Instagram[/url][/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Empires Mobile[/h1]
[h3]The first look at a brand new [i]AoE[/i] world[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/04e81076b1fbfe05cba29e08b4d0ca5379d88ad4.png[/img]
At our 25th anniversary event we announced [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] and we’ve been getting questions from intrigued and excited players ever since.

Today we’re so excited to unveil this partnership with the fantastic team at TiMi Studio Group, who are bringing this brand-new [i]Age of Empires[/i] world to life. [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] is a mobile war strategy game where players will embark on an exhilarating adventure and forge unbreakable bonds with friends. Featuring rich real-time controls, stunning visuals and historical heroes on grand battlefields, this addition to the franchise has so much to offer.

The game features elements from [i]Age of Empires[/i] games, merged with brand-new and mobile-specific gameplay. You’ll engage in strategic resource management, develop unique technologies and train diverse armies to build and defend your kingdom.

In the New Year New Age show, we premiered the first gameplay trailer for [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] as well as a behind the scenes look with the team at TiMi Studio Group.

You can pre-register now for [i]Age of Empires Mobile[/i] on iOS and Google Play. For more information about the game, visit [url=http://www.aoemobile.com/]www.aoemobile.com[/url].

[h1]Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado[/h1]
[h3]Happening this year![/h3]
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/4887141f8219f1079c00721f8b413be19730980a.png[/img][/td][td]The [i]Age of Empires[/i] eSports scene continues to flourish, and we couldn’t be more grateful to the tournament organizers, players and supporters who continue to create exciting events, mesmerizing moments and valiant victories year in, year out.[/td][/tr][/table]
Our partners and friends at Red Bull gave us the great honor today to announce that their next [i]Age of Empires[/i] event, Red Bull Wololo: El Reinado will be coming in 2024!

Whilst we’re not ready to share the details just yet, we recommend subscribing to [i]Age of Empires[/i] and Red Bull Gaming channels to be sure you don’t miss information when we share it in the not-too-distant future.
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/h1]
[h3]New DLC coming late 2024[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/baa9dcf2f46f65d6048e004bbe9db4d69b68a687.png[/img]
One final announcement for the show was that we’ll be bringing [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] players another DLC at the end of 2024!

Whilst we can’t spill all of the details at this point, Director of Production Earnest Yuen was able to sneak in a couple of spoilers…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/f36b4565d19604946667fdf1ba2eb4c12df37b29.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Thank you for a Fantastic 2023![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/175fceb1ee0d967f0b39d06cf3cc50948d176ac2.png[/img]
In 2023 [i]Age of Empires[/i]:
[list][*] Launched two titles on Xbox consoles and cloud
[*] Released the best-selling [i]Age of Empires[/i] expansion of all time, [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]
[*] Released the two fastest selling [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] DLC ever, [i]Return of Rome[/i] and [i]The Mountain Royals[/i]
[*] Managed 51 game updates
[*] Our players performed 200 million Wololos, built 350 million castles and employed 1.5 billion valiant scout sheep[/list]It was truly the biggest year for [i]Age of Empires[/i] yet! Thank you to over 50 million players worldwide who have joined us on our journey so far.

We have so much lined up for 2024 and can’t wait to bring you along with us.

[previewyoutube=FqPOlAJC3sQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
That’s the rundown of the show! Head to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ageofempires][i]Age of Empires[/i] YouTube channel[/url] if you want to rewatch any of what we showed today.

A heartfelt thank you to each and every one who’s played [i]Age of Empires[/i] so far. It’s your love and passion that has kept this franchise going for the last 26 years and we can’t wait for these new chapters in our epic story in 2024.

notes.title: New Year, New Age Livestream Coming February 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/6d8428c32661f365537c177c520b8085bb02cf56.jpg[/img]
It’s a new year and a time to reset, reflect and think about what the next few months has in store. 
 
Here on the [i]Age of Empires[/i] team, we’ve got a LOT lined up for 2024. Instead of trying to summarize it in a lengthy blog post, we decided to make a show of it! We’re excited to announce the “New Year, New Age” [b]livestream[/b] on [b]February 23rd at 10:00 am PT (1:00 pm ET / 18:00 UTC).[/b] 

With so much to come in 2024, we want to show our players around the world what to expect from the Age of Empires franchise this year. We’ll be revealing more information on some of our most anticipated titles for 2024 – so expect to see a sneak peek of [i][b]Age of Mythology: Retold[/b][/i] and a first look at [i][b]Age of Empires Mobile[/b][/i]. If you’re eager to know what’s next for our games already in your library, don’t worry, we’ll have updates for those titles too. 
[list]
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition:[/b][/i] We’ll reveal a brand-new campaign-focused expansion and an extended look at exclusive gameplay. 
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition:[/b][/i] After giving our players a new way to play for free in 2023, we are excited to reveal a new DLC with new civilizations.  
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires IV:[/b][/i] Coming off our best-selling expansion ever with The Sultans Ascend, we will share updates on an upcoming brand-new season and a new in-game reward. 
[*] [i][b]Age of Empires Mobile:[/b][/i] TiMi Studio Group, the award-winning developer, will share a first-time look at gameplay and give us a behind the scenes look into their studio. The team will share their passion for Age of Empires and their vision to bring the franchise to new and existing fans alike.  
[*] [i][b]Age of Mythology: Retold:[/b][/i] The team will take us behind the curtain in the studio to show how they are developing this beloved game for a new, modern experience. Fans can expect a unique unveiling of a few mythological creatures that you won’t want to miss. 
[/list]Lastly, making a return appearance after hosting our 25th anniversary show, Welyn, will be streaming the event on his Twitch channel. He’ll give his expert impressions and reactions to all the news, reveals, teases and gameplay.   

Mark your calendars for [b]February 23rd at 10:00 am PT[/b] to watch on the channels listed below: 
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/welyn]Welyn’s Twitch[/url]  
[*] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/ageofempires]Age of Empires Twitch [/url]
[*] [url=http://www.youtube.com/ageofempires]Age of Empires YouTube[/url] 
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/AgeOfEmpires]Age of Empires Steam Page [/url]
[*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/]Age of Empires.com [/url]
[/list] We’re so grateful to get to spend another year bringing established and new players all over the world more [i]Age of Empires[/i] content. We hope you’ll join us at New Year, New Age as we take a look at what’s to come. 

Stay tuned to [i]Age of Empires[/i] channels for more details about the show over the next coming weeks.  

See you there! 

For more [i]Age of Empires[/i] information, visit [url=www.ageofempires.com ]www.ageofempires.com [/url]
