notes.title: Age of Empires IV – Patch 9.1.370
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/1b0fec3bf3a9f984649f9e5b3c6570ca7e1f59fa.jpg[/img]
The festive season is in the air in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] with today’s minor patch (December 6th) – join in the fun with our upcoming Tons o’ Toys seasonal event, chill out in our seasonal Winter biome, or bring the heat to your opponent with the updates to the new civilizations [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/age-of-empires-iv/the-sultans-ascend/][u]introduced in our recent expansion[/u][/url]! Changes introduced today include: 

[list]
[*] Stability fixes for campaign and multiplayer. 
[*] Additional fixes to improve server latency, meant to pair with improvements made in recent server maintenances. 
[*] Adjustments to several maps. 
[*] Several corrections to localization.
[*] A new official mod: Free Camera.
[*] Balance changes focused around the Japanese and Byzantines, as well as the variant civilizations. 
[*] …plus bug fixes and further balance improvements. [/list]
Read more below. 

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/] Official Forum[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/] Steam Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
[quote]Please Note: As part of updating to this latest build, any saved games and observable matches made on previous builds will be unable to be loaded or replayed.[/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-patch-9-1-370/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆Patch 9.1.370◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Seasonal Event: Tons o' Toys[/h2]
Stay frosty this winter season with our Tons o’ Toys seasonal event! Complete these cool challenges to unlock a flurry of in-game rewards. Unwrap these presents while you can! [b]Tons o’ Toys is scheduled to run from mid-December through 11:59pm PT on Jan 11th, 2024 (07:59 UTC on Jan 12th, 2024). [/b]

We will be releasing a small hotfix build to light-up this event early next-week. If there is any delay of this event, we will communicate this status on the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] [url=https://discord.com/channels/585165441790509094/585568729333760002] game news channel of our Discord.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7d7d65e8c105c09727dca1055d5e5e86195c7efc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/77839f657fc6e7308fd5d132df8b9ebbfcbac9ad.png[/img]
[i]In-game text for the “Long Trip” incorrectly indicates this challenge is unlocked by playing an Empire Wars match. Please refer to the above challenge list for the updated text.[/i]

[h3]Login Event – Surprise Inside[/h3]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/c4871630cff6ba4a923399d4daca1124de410d2a.jpg[/img][/td][td]A gift just for you! Starting in mid-December, login to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] to claim a special present-themed sigil for your Coat of Arms! This login event will start alongside Tons o’ Toys, and run through 11:59pm PT on December 19th (19:59 UTC on December 20th).[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3]Seasonal Biome - Winter[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7cf8de8e51a554c52b070763c1a475c1e627b140.png[/img]
[i]A snowy, northern landscape in the chill of winter.[/i] 

The Winter biome will be available in-game starting today (December 6th) and will be available in skirmish and custom lobbies until a planned patch in early 2024.[/quote]
[quote][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/69b1e33a6a7d18d031e01482255a19952084757d.png[/img]
[h3]Stability Fixes[/h3]
A number of compounding events led to server issues reported on November 18th and 19th. Since then, we’ve taken several steps to improve server latency and stability, including the previously communicated server maintenance windows on November 23rd and 29th. This patch also includes some game-side fixes meant to act in tandem with improvements already made to the server. Thank you all for the reports during this time.  

[h3]Map Adjustments[/h3]
Our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-patch-9-1-109/][u]most recent major update[/u][/url] introduced 3 new maps, [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-sultans-ascend-everything-in-the-expansion/][u]while our expansion[/u][/url] added an additional 10. Several balance changes and bug fixes have been made to some of these and existing maps, detailed in Maps section further on. 

[h3]Localization[/h3]
Several players have noted that some of the translations in our expansion were inconsistent with the quality of localization for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Thanks to community reporting, we have identified some of these mistranslations and today’s patch fixes many of them, especially with our Chinese localizations. 

We welcome further input and discussion [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/age-of-empires-iv-bugs/185][u]on the [i]Age[/i] Forums[/u][/url], where our community heroes have already been hard at work. Thank you! 

[h3]New Official Mod: Free Camera [/h3]
By popular request, we are introducing a new official mod to allow creators to freely move the camera for taking videos and screenshots. The “Free Camera” mod unlocks the camera from its default constraints and allows movement around without limit. 

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
With the introduction of 2 new civilizations and 4 variant civilizations, most of today’s balance changes are focused on the impact these new additions have had on recent gameplay and as such there are more balance changes than typical for our minor patches. You can read more about these in the Civilization-Specific Changes section below.[/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

notes.title: Age of Empires IV – Update 9.1.109
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/05f35849ee09c2144118af4a20f7fac26875c5df.png[/img]
[quote][i][b]NOTE[/b] – Our build number for this update has slightly changed (from 9.1.109 to 9.1.176) to correct some localization issues; no other changes have been made between these builds and the previously published release notes are still accurate.[/i][/quote]
Fall is in the air, and our upcoming major update for [i]Age of Empires IV: Anniversary [/i]Edition([b]November 14th[/b]) is stuffed with goodies! We’re cooking up a new Ranked Season, including a map pool rotation with a side of brand-new maps! And don’t forget to grab a slice of fun with our Fireside Festivities seasonal event!

Fill you plate with the changes in this update, including: 
[list][*] 3 new maps – Canal, Gorge, & Rocky River 
[*] Expansion-exclusive maps join the Ranked map pool for a limited time 
[*] Empire Wars comes to Quick Match 
[*] Walls are easier and simpler to build 
[*] Several updates to AI 
[*] Plus balance changes and bug fixes[/list]
[quote]The changes listed in this major update will be released alongside [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] expansion on [b]November 14th[/b]. These are separate from the expansion, and available to all owners of [i]Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition[/i]. For more information about what is included in the expansion, please see our blog [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-sultans-ascend-everything-in-the-expansion/][i]The Sultans Ascend[/i]: Everything in the Expansion[/url].[/quote]
[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/] Official Forum[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/] Steam Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote]Please Note: As part of updating to this latest build, any saved games and observable matches made on previous builds will be unable to be loaded or replayed.[/quote]

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-9-1-109/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Update 9.1.109◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Season Six[/h2]
Snuggle-up and get cozy with our Fireside Festivities seasonal event! Compete in themed challenges to earn in-game rewards. Fireside Festivities runs from [b]November 14th at 10am PT (18:00 UTC) through December 4th at 11:59pm PT (Dec 5th at 07:59 UTC). [/b]

[quote][h3]New! Fireside Festivities Event[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/e6c8fefd7899e1827ca27e245f60651a544a1c22.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/5a4b91c8b99455bc9585db6fdc9eba3fc86164ac.png[/img]
[/quote]
[quote][h3]Ranked Season Updates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/66de66bcdcd0233fe37ce517810c725ee5ed9c9d.png[/img]
Season Five is coming to a close and Ranked Season Six is right on its tail!

[b]Season Five will end on November 13th at 11:59pm PT (Nov 14th at 07:59 UTC).[/b] For the first time, rewards will be delivered based on the highest rank achieved throughout the season! Be sure to visit your profile page in-game after the season has ended to claim your rewards! 

But don’t rest on your laurels too long! [b]Season Six begins on November 15th at 10:00am PT (18:00 UTC).[/b] Charge into the fray to earn new rewards and climb the ladder to victory! Season Six runs until [b]March 13th at 11:59pm PT (March 14th at 06:59 UTC).[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/65ecebb190c9490223d939b408cb6e4a10414adb.png[/img]
[h4]Map Pool Rotation[/h4]
A new Ranked Season means a fresh change of the map pool, and we have some special treats in store! 

First, this update includes 3 new maps which are immediately debuting on the roster – [b]Canal[/b], [b]Gorge[/b], and [b]Rocky River[/b] – more about these new maps further on in the Build Spotlight section. 

Additionally, we have 4 new maps joining the pool from [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] expansion! While these maps will normally be exclusive to owners of the expansion, [i][b]all players[/b][/i] will be able to preview these maps for a limited time through playing in Ranked matches! Check them out before the next map rotation! 
[quote]More information about the maps available with [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] can be found on our blog ([url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-sultans-ascend-everything-in-the-expansion/][i]The Sultans Ascend[/i]: Everything in the Expansion[/url]). It is our intention to routinely preview expansion-exclusive maps through the Ranked play map pool rotations, so that all players have an opportunity to experience some of the expansion’s additional content. [/quote]
Season Six changes to the map pool take effect on [b]November 15th at 10am PT (18:00 UTC)![/b]

[b]Quick Match Changes[/b]
[list][*] The number of downvotes for maps in Quick Match has increased from 7 to 15. 
[*] Empire Wars is now selectable as a game mode for Quick Match.[/list]
[b]1v1 Ranked Map Pool [/b]
[list]
[*] Arabia 
[*] Canal ([i]NEW![/i]) 
[*] Cliffside ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Golden Heights 
[*] Golden Pit ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Gorge ([i]NEW![/i]) 
[*] Hidden Valley ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Himeyama ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Rocky River ([i]NEW![/i])[/list]
[b]Team Ranked Map Pool [/b]
[list][*] Arabia 
[*] Cliffside ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Golden Heights 
[*] Golden Pit ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Gorge ([i]NEW![/i]) 
[*] Hidden Valley ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Hideout 
[*] Himeyama ([i]Expansion Preview![/i]) 
[*] Volcanic Island[/list]
[/quote]
[/quote]
[quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/69b1e33a6a7d18d031e01482255a19952084757d.png[/img]
[h3]Empire Wars in Quick Match[/h3]
By popular demand, the Empire Wars game mode is now available as an option in Quick Match! Enjoy the early-game head-start provided by Empire Wars to launch into a fast-paced mid-game; now it is easier than ever to queue-up and play! 

[h3]New Maps![/h3]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/f7c19612078f5874140f8a79e932c6ff2b6ab9a0.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Canal[/b]
A wide canal stretches from base to base through a fertile land, carving a path for both resources and aggression.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/afb6ca8837f4e2595df482cb42bc27f7a2aaa1e0.png[/img][/td][td][b]Gorge [/b]
Nothing but an open land separates you from your enemies in the gorge. Above the gorge to the side of the mountain are small forests and plenty of resources awaiting those daring to branch off the central battle.[/td][/tr]
[tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/1515084b9e3fbd4ce98526086c89394ae1c63a8e.png[/img][/td][td][b]Rocky River[/b] 
New life emerges from the dying remains of a once great river, stretching low across a valley between opposing factions.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3]Mega Walls Update[/h3]
Walls are now simpler and easier to place and utilize by players. From improvements such as better Villager building logic and construction UI, to completely new features such as linking to allied walls and a functional overhaul to gates – how you lay out your base and defend your civilization will be forever changed! Read more about these updates in the Balance & Bugfixes section below. 

[h3]Town Bell[/h3]
Ding Ding! Now available at the Town Center; ring the Town Bell to call all nearby Villagers back to safety with the press of a single button. The Town Bell is fully compatible with Seek Shelter and both methods of garrisoning Villagers share the same return to work hotkeys. 

[h3]Landmark and Wonder Resizing[/h3]
We have increased the visual size of several Landmarks and Wonders to be more visually appealing. This is purely a visual change and impacted buildings still take up the same amount of build-space. 

[h3]Mods & Content Editor[/h3]
[list][*] Added a progress bar to the UI for the “Finalizing Publish” phase. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Content Editor would crash after removing an Enum entry.[/list][/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-9-1-109/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

notes.title: The Sultans Ascend: Variant Civilizations Deep Dive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/97cb27d031073e28635771507c2ee5f6e764693a.png[/img]
[i]The Sultans Ascend[/i], the new expansion for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is coming [b]November 14th[/b] and is available for pre-order now!

The upcoming expansion will bring a host of new ways to play, including:
[list][*] New 8-mission campaign
[*] 2 new civilizations: Japanese & Byzantines
[*] 4 new variant civilizations
[*] 10 new maps
[*] 2 new biomes
[*] New unlockable rewards[/list]
Between now and launch, we’ll be sharing deeper looks at what’s included in the expansion. After hearing player feedback we’re starting with a deep dive on Variant Civilizations, which are new to both [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], and the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise as a whole. We’re pairing this deep dive with a look at the [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/age-of-empires-iv/civilizations/jeanne-darc/]Jeanne d’Arc Variant Civilization[/url] so you can learn more about how it’s structured, the new elements you’ll have to play with, and allow you to start thinking of strategies.

[h2]What is a Variant Civilization?[/h2]
A Variant Civilization is a modified version of a classic civilization that you already know and love from the core game. They offer new gameplay elements and strategies, while keeping the familiarity and identity of the classic civilization intact. Variant civilizations are not designed to replace the classic civ they are derived from but instead provide an alternative way to play.

We start with historical inspiration from some element in the history of the classic civilization and then build gameplay from that theme. These elements can be a single individual (like Jeanne d’Arc), a philosophy (like the neo-Confucianism of Zhu Xi), or a particular historical group within the broader culture (like the Order of the Dragon). Although these seeds are often small moments, we explore the ‘what if’ of keeping that focus throughout the journey through the four Ages. Historically, Jeanne d’Arc lived at what would be the early part of the Imperial Age (just as France was adopting firearms at large scale), but we feature her across all four Ages in the variant that bears her name.

This builds on some of the “historical extensions” of the classic civilizations, such as the Abbasid Dynasty and Delhi Sultanate having full gunpowder units even through those particular groups never adopted gunpowder en masse (or were succeeded by those who did, such as the Ottomans).

Not everything changes between classic and variant. Many basic units and buildings remain the same, as do music and historical speech. Each variant has its own list of changes, which might be a new set of landmarks, new units, revised or wholly new technologies or civilization mechanics, and more. The changes are always significant, however, and remake how the civilization plays. Players of a parent and variant civilization will be making very different choices and pursuing different strategies throughout a match.

[h2]Why are Variant Civilizations being introduced?[/h2]
First and foremost, all civilizations in [i]Age of Empires[/i] (be they classics or variants) are there to deliver excellent and engaging experiences to our players. The classic civilizations are there to capture the history of civilizations over several centuries, capturing the evolution of whole cultures and expressing them as broad gameplay themes supported by art, music, speech, and much more. Variant civilizations take an element of that broad historical sweep and build a fresh game experience around it.

The variant civilizations are also a great opportunity for us to explore gameplay mechanics that push the envelope. The Jeanne d’Arc Variant Civilization, for example, is entirely focused on a hero unit who gains levels and transforms throughout the match. This is not something we have seen in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] before, and variants allow us to really lean into these mechanics.

[h2]What was the inspiration for Variant Civilizations?[/h2]
History is always the first source of inspiration for the [i]Age of Empires[/i] team, but we also look to our community and how they play the game. Looking at the landscape of play, we saw opportunities for fun RTS experiences we hadn’t yet explored. To cite just one example, we realized we had gone into elite units, but not an elite army. What would an [i]Age of Empires[/i] version of a low-unit-count army of powerful units look like? What benefits would that provide to players struggling with cognitive load? What awesome gameplay moments could that deliver? From there was born the Order of the Dragon.

[h2]Since announcing the Variant Civilizations, you’ve changed two of the names. Why is this?[/h2]
The names for the Variant Civilizations are:
[list][*] Jeanne d’Arc (variant of the French)
[*] The Order of the Dragon (variant of the Holy Roman Empire)
[*] Zhu Xi’s Legacy (variant of the Chinese)
[*] Ayyubids (variant of the Abbasid Dynasty)[/list]
Naming things is difficult. We need to balance historicity with trying to represent what is unique about a civilization. We talk a lot about names. We try out options. We consult with experts. We test and reflect. But sometimes we miss things or get things wrong. Some members of our community raised concerns that a few of our names were needlessly vague and needlessly exoticizing. World’s Edge and Relic take such concerns very seriously, and after much discussion and consultation with experts, we have decided to make some changes. We won’t always get things right, but we are listening and always learning and we appreciate you sharing your thoughts with us. Your voices are a part of our development process and we’ll continue to hear them.
[hr][/hr]
Want more information of the other elements of [i]The Sultans Ascend[/i] expansion? Keep an eye on our website and official community channels for information as we release it. You can also pre-order the expansion now!

notes.title: Age of Empires IV – Update 8.1.185
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/92606942caf0cc33aee13b3c09324447318af1a4.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] comes to Xbox consoles with this exciting update! We’d like to extend a warm welcome to all of our new players!

While today’s update (August 22nd) is predominantly focused on supporting the launch on Xbox consoles, there are still a few changes coming to PC. Note that crossplay between Xbox consoles and PC is not supported with this update; you can reference our full [i]Age of Empires IV: Anniversary Edition[/i] on Xbox consoles [b][url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/18308207489044]FAQ here[/url][/b].

A quick breakdown of changes also introduced on PC includes:
[list][*] Several changes to AI behavior – especially with the Scout 
[*] Rebalancing of relics on certain maps 
[*] … plus bug fixes and balance changes
[/list]
[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/] Official Forum[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/] Steam Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Update 8.1.185◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[h3]AI Updates[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue that caused the AI to miscalculate the damage of buildings with garrisoned units. AI should no longer treat outposts as harmless if there are units inside. 
[*] Mongol AI will place blacksmith and some military production buildings near Ovoo when relocating to take advantage of improved technologies. 
[*] AI’s logic for assigning villagers to gather from resources has been improved.   
[*] AI army will now try to move in formation when traveling to attack or defend a target. Siege engines and slower units will now move together with faster units giving AI a better chance to utilize the whole army. 
[*] Issue with AI archers being idle after fleeing has been fixed. 
[*] AI will now build the first mining camp close to its Town Center early in the game. 
[*] AI now uses more villagers to construct landmarks and wonders.   
[*] AI will fall back from battles it is losing more reliably. 
[*] AI player’s monks will now correctly travel with, heal, and buff their allies. 
[*] AI is now more restricted for executing market trades. It won’t execute trade for resources that it needs when it’s gathering same resource decently. It will only go for market trades that make sense. 
[*] Accelerated and generally improved AI’s first Town Center placement logic in Nomad mode. 
[*] Fixed AI sometimes repeatedly choosing the same bad spot to build their first Town Center in Nomad mode, destroying it and trying again or sometimes completely failing to choose a good construction spot. 
[/list]
[h3]AI Scout Changes[/h3]
[list][*] AI players will now actively scout for nearby enemy units after they have been harassed in their territory. 
[*] AI scouts now collect sheep in Revealed games. 
[*] AI’s scouts drop sheep off at the base more often. 
[*] Scout pathfinding when grabbing sheep has been improved around shores. 
[*] AI will use their scouts to observe enemy bases more often. 
[*] AI’s scouts no longer deliver sheep to allies on revealed maps. 
[*] AI players’ scouts will no longer attempt to steal sheep from near allied bases. 
[/list]
[h3]Campaign[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tech Trees option has been removed from the pause menu. 
[/list]
[quote][i][b]Developer’s Note:[/b] Removing this view from campaigns is our design solution to confusion experienced by newer players, as the technology and units in the campaigns deviate significantly from the Tech Trees used in Skirmish and Multiplayer matches.[/i][/quote]
[list][*] Fixed a bug in campaign missions where a villager would not automatically build a structure if placed where the villager is standing. 
[*] Fixed a problem that could cause the enemy AI to stop attacking during the Lumen Shan mission. 
[/list]
[h3]Masteries[/h3]
[list][*] The Clever Commerce French Mastery description has been updated for clarity. 
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Quick Study” achievement was not awarded if the Ottoman or Malian masteries were completed. 
[/list]
[h3]UX/UI & Menus (All Platforms)[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue to ensure Mod tooltips will appear wide enough to contain the full mod title without breaking the characters into multiple lines. 
[*] Fixed an issue to ensure that if Voice Chat has been disabled, it can be re-enabled during a match. 
[*] The relic icon is now centered, when selecting a building with a relic inside. 
[*] The resource in the deposit and the extraction rate stats are now on the same line when selecting the Ovoo. The player’s name is not cut off anymore. 
[/list]
[/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-8-1-185/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

notes.title: New Free Trial Comes to AoE III: DE on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/4beb0c9fa0c4aebbbc3527b4a0453852bfe6eee4.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] is launching a new way to play! For the first time, new players can now join the ranks of this historical and stunning RTS experience with a rotating roster of the game’s 16 civilizations which can be played in both single player and multiplayer games FREE of purchase on Steam.

Now is the time to try [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]! Play for the first time or current [i]AoE III: DE[/i] players can invite their friends for epic battles in striking 4K Ultra HD graphics.

Starting today,[i] AoE III: DE[/i] will be offering new players the opportunity to play a free trial that gives access to the following:
[list][*] 3 civs on a rotating schedule for skirmish & multiplayer matches
[*] 8 hostable maps
[*] Act 1 of the Blood, Ice, and Steel campaign
[*] Art of War challenges
[*] And more![/list]
Plus, [i]all[/i] players will be able to join in on monthly global events to unlock new Hero Cosmetics!

[quote][h2]How to Access[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/b291508fda672265c9b11a0d520d94524b49d105.png[/img]
Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition is now available to download for free on Steam! New players can jump into a trial version simply by downloading the game on Steam, and open to access straight from the menu!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933110/Age_of_Empires_III_Definitive_Edition/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/923931c01c9d8780487af2c130b9d8407bd347b4.png[/img][/url]
[quote]Already own [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i]? Then fear not, as this will not impact current players. All you have to do is invite your friends![/quote]
Or, are you ready to access [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] base game with all the civilizations and extras? Get the base game instead!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477660][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/fdad2f8c05137c5333728e12b7bea108667255c9.png[/img][/url]
[/quote]
[quote][h2]What is Included?[/h2]
[quote][h3]Pool of 3 Playable Civilizations on a Rotating Schedule[/h3]
Players can pick from 3 civilizations on a rotating schedule. Every week, the first civilization adding to the starting pool rotates out and a new one in. First up in the roster of playable civilizations are the [b]French, Haudenosaunee, and Russians.[/b]

[table equalcells=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/ebe651aba2a22941b4621db20a67e04d485fb500.png[/img][/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/4e1fea7c9be0583710cf382e6cc351c3979c2fe8.png[/img][/td] [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/4d663597a3f8a4ee1ebedb27caee8b9b9631cbe1.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
[quote][b]First civilization rotation is on August 18th.[/b][/quote][/quote]
[quote][h3]The First Act of the Blood, Ice, and Steel Campaign[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/e9290b9637f37952125214185dede6ec71154780.png[/img]
Take advantage of the first campaign and jump into an epic journey!

Follow Morgan Black; Knight of St. John on his quest to the New World. Do battle with the hardy Ottoman Empire, ferocious pirates and a dangerous secret society. Befriend unlikely allies and earn their aid to complete your quest of defeating the Circle of Ossus; and their plans to obtain eternal life.[/quote]
[quote][h3]Play the Algiers Historical Battle[/h3]
Historical battles are story-driven historical narratives in which you’ll be given specific set objectives to complete. Each Historical battle has fully voiced in-game dialogue, beautifully crafted maps, cities and cinematics and the best part is, you can play them with a friend!

[b]Where to Find Co-Op:[/b]
Co-Op is easily accessible from two different places within the UI.

[b]From the Historical Battles screen.[/b]
[olist]
[*] From the Main Menu, click on Historical Battles.
[*] Select your mission.
[*] Click on the Host Co-Op button.
[*] You can choose to make it public or password protected, and like any multiplayer game, invite your friends.
[/olist]
[b]From the Multiplayer screen.[/b]
[olist]
[*] From the Main Menu, click on Multiplayer.
[*] Choose Host a Casual Game.
[*] From the Host Game dialog pop-up, under Game Mode, you can choose Co-Op Battle from drop down list.
[*] After selecting Co-Op Battle, simply choose which battle you want to play from the Co-Op Scenario drop down list.[/olist]
[b]Algiers Historical Battle[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/ab9f65ba5bbe705a95fdb008bd98f4ab665348c6.png[/img]

In the 16th century privateering in the Mediterranean flourished as a result of the staunch rivalry between the Ottoman Empires and the European Christian states. Famous Barbary corsairs like Hayreddin Barbarossa and his brothers gained infamy because of their great success while privateering. In 1516 the brothers managed to take the city of Algiers, deposing its former ruler, and creating their own Barbary pirate state. However, the Spanish were not going to let a pirate state exist so close to their homeland and sent a large army to deal with the Barbary threat and acquire the city of Algiers.

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe-iii-de-co-op-is-here/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/0196c66c699df61183e0a28ef57b41e0dc4639e9.png[/img][/url]
[/quote]
[quote][h3]Access to the Art of War, Compendium, and Tech Trees of All Civilizations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/aef6b9a6636a0a19d2698a729526587332e9d972.png[/img]
[b]Art of War[/b]
Hone your skills and strategy with the Art of War – a set of 10 in-game tutorials designed to quickly teach the core skills you’ll need to win!

[b]Compendium[/b]
Explore the history of each civilization, their military, buildings and more in the in-game Compendium.

[b]Tech Trees[/b]
Learn the strategies and tactics available to each civilization in the Technology Tree. Detailing their unique roster of units, technologies, and bonuses to unlock their true potential.[/quote]
[quote][h3]A Collection of 8 Hostable Multiplayer Maps[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/02dc03627ee5878a1df5fc13881eb66d9d918c96.png[/img]
Host a match and choose from 8 Maps!

[b]🌐 Central Asia:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/3af3dfdb39c128413f36f318c2391da2e03fd075.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Central Asia:[/b] Teams are separated by two shallow rivers that flow into the Aral Sea in this arid region.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Tengri, Sufi.

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Wokou Horseman, Wokou Monk.[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Deccan:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/0a2cf6131a48505342943a5e2154e2983a00ff29.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Deccan:[/b] A central, forested plateau overlooking a series of strategically placed trade sites.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Udasi, Sufi, Bhakti

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Marathan Dacoit, Marathan Thuggee[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Great Plains:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/7455b299a94db676dd277ff44de40777388a9469.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Great Plains:[/b] Home of many Natives and plenty of Food.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Comanche, Cheyenne, Apache

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Comanchero, Renegado[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Guianas:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/7460f25ebdd92ab63fd7de07204e080563903de9.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Guianas:[/b] Control the central resources and settlements in this large valley, or extend to the perimeter of the map to establish a foothold on a trade route.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Caribs, Tupi

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Pistolero, Pirate[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Northwest Territory:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/c1ad68d12583e57bf7b4b8918bb6114fd6cd8873.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Northwest Territory:[/b] A green and rainy region divided by rivers with shallow crossings.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Nootka, Klamath, Cree

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Comanchero, Renegado[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Malaysia:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/70b3e1a0fde545ebfc5a844887ba68418bb1c1bf.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Malaysia:[/b] A peninsular region with separate, defendable oceans on each side.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Jesuit, Sufi

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Marathan Dacoit, Wokou Pirate[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Mongolia:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/9af5adfcaae27ab6b6f482b3328462e49843f9cf.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Mongolia:[/b] Explore generous grassland populated with unprecedented herds of grazing animals and a distant northern Trade Route.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Tengri, Shaolin

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Wokou Horseman, Wokou Monk[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[b]🌐 Saguenay:[/b][expand type=details][table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/b9ddd3009c57fa34fe0b55ae1128e263b85336a4.png[/img][/td][td]
[b]Saguenay:[/b] A coastal region with plenty of resources. It may be summer or winter.

[b]Settlements:[/b] Cree, Huron

[b]Outlaws:[/b] Pistolero, Comanchero[/td][/tr][/table][/expand]
[/quote][/quote]
[quote][h2]New Global Events! Unlock New Hero Cosmetics[/h2]
[b]Starting August 2[/b], all players will be able to participate in a Hero Cosmetic challenge event each month! The aim of each of the events is the same – to have a target number of participants join and play to reach the goal of unlocking that month’s Hero Cosmetic to use in game.

In order to participate in the challenge, simply play a single player or multiplayer game to earn XP and gain entry to a leaderboard for the challenge. When there are enough entries on the leaderboard a Hero Cosmetics is awarded to anyone who participates in the challenge.

To find the event progress, navigate to the UI panel on the Main Menu. Statistics are displayed for the following:
[list][*] Target number of participants
[*] Current number of participants
[*] Icon and description of the Hero Cosmetic reward[/list]
[table][tr][td]Featured Civilization: August[/td][td]Reward[/td][td]Cosmetic[/td][/tr][tr][td]Russians[/td][td][b]Mila the Bear [/b]
Look into those big wide eyes,
could that bear ever harm anyone?
She just wants to play! Hurl around 
those enemy soldiers through the air!
[/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38625628/90107ce6bb7a93b864c64619740655a68221fe00.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table][/quote]
[quote][h2]FAQ[/h2]
1) Will the free trial version be available on Windows Store?[expand type=details]This will be available on Steam only. [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] is available for free via Game Pass![/expand]
2) I already own [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i], will this affect me?[expand type=details]This will not impact current [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] owners. However this will be the chance to invite friends and new players to try it out![/expand]
3) Will ranked be available in the free trial version?[expand type=details]Ranked is available only in the base game, which [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477660]can be purchased here[/url].[/expand]
4) Will free trial players be able to play with players who own the base game?[expand type=details]Yes, trial game players can play with base game owners, and both game owner types can host multiplayer games.

If trial players hosts a multiplayer game, they can choose from the limited set of maps available to host on. If a base game owner hosts, any owned maps can be chosen for the map, and trial game players can join the game even if they don’t own the map.[/expand]

[h3]Need more help? Visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/360049678131]our support page here[/url]![/h3]
[/quote]

[h1]Want Access to All the Civilizations and Extras?[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477660

notes.title: Empire Wars has come to Age of Empires IV!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/bd60f608d9538a6ee362338e77108da698188ed9.png[/img]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Season Five introduces [u][b]Empire Wars[/b][/u], a new, quick-to-action game mode! Players start their game with an already-burgeoning empire, ready to dive into combat or advance to the next Age.

Available in custom and skirmish matches, in this new game mode the player begins with a variety of buildings alongside a distribution of working villagers, which creates a foothold on the map for players to expand from. Villagers will already be busy working farms, chopping trees, and mining gold and stone. 

Empire Wars has the same win conditions as Standard game mode and is available on all maps. No starting town is the same. Will your empire prevail? 

[h2]Choosing the Mode[/h2]
To begin, select Empire Wars among the game modes in any Custom or Skirmish game setup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/12d3247e688922fbbb2e6f0121e09cfbcb8120e1.png[/img]
[h2]Start Conditions[/h2]
In Empire Wars, the player’s economy is balanced around expanding your empire quickly. Each player starts with a distinct town, made up of pre-built buildings that maximize their chosen civilization’s strengths, as well as villagers and some special units already assigned to different tasks. Choose how you would like to use these resources to quickly gain an advantage. 

Please see the detailed breakdown of starting allocations for each civilization below!

[h2]The Empire Wars Start[/h2]
Each civilization in Empire Wars begins a match with the following Units, Buildings and Resources available, then receives additional unique bonuses to aid their playstyle as noted below.

[h3]Overall Starting Buildings and Units:[/h3]
[list][*] 23 Villagers already collecting resources
[*] 4 Villagers in the queue of the Town Center
[*] 2 Scouts
[*] Mill
[*] Lumber Camp
[*] Mining Camp[/list]
[h3]Overall Civilization Starting Resources:[/h3]
[list][*] 100 Food
[*] 200 Wood
[*] 150 Gold
[*] 0 Stone[/list]

[h3]Abbasid Dynasty[/h3][expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/3cf84f4165356e0c522c2dca5538201a40ff99be.jpg[/img]
[h4]Additional Buildings:[/h4]
[list]
[*] Market
[*] House of Wisdom
[*] An additional 4 Houses, for a combination of 8 Houses within influence of the House of Wisdom
[/list]
[h4]Starting Villagers Locations:[/h4]
[list]
[*] 4 collecting from Sheep at the Town Center
[*] 8 collecting Berries at Mill
[*] 6 collecting Wood at Lumber Camp
[*] 5 collecting Gold at the Mining Camp
[/list]
[/expand]
[h3]Chinese[/h3][expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/0f71a2aca16e1a980e6ad9e59e77d7d9b18c078e.jpg[/img]
[h4]Additional Buildings and Units:[/h4]
[list]
[*] 1 Village and 2 Houses
[list][*] Instead of the standard 4 Houses[/list]
[*] 2 Imperial Officials supervising the Lumber Camp and Mill
[list][*] 2 less starting Villagers[/list]
[/list]
[h4]Starting Villager Locations:[/h4]
[list]
[*] 11 collecting Food from Sheep at the Mill
[*] 6 collecting Wood at Lumber Camp
[*] 4 collecting Gold at the Mining Camp
[/list][/expand]
[h3]Delhi Sultanate[/h3][expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/a5f8692ea9f5ae1c716b11dd1e9fb512f3cc61e3.jpg[/img]
[h4]Additional Starting Buildings, Units & Research:[/h4]
[list]
[*] Mosque with 3 garrisoned Scholars
[*] Forestry, Efficient Production and Wheelbarrow research in progress
[/list]
[h4]Starting Villager Locations:[/h4]
[list]
[*] 4 collecting Food from Sheep at the Town Center
[*] 8 collecting Food from Berries at the Mill
[*] 6 collecting Wood at Lumber Camp
[*] 5 collecting Gold at the Mining Camp
[/list]
[/expand]
[h3]English[/h3][expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/7adf30b21b8c8198f83d26440fa92f7095d2fdef.jpg[/img]
[h4]Additional Starting Buildings:[/h4]
[list][*] 8 Farms around the Mill[/list]
[h4]Starting Villager Locations:[/h4]
[list]
[*] 4 collecting Food from Sheep at the Town Center
[*] 8 collection Food from Farms at the Mill
[*] 6 collecting Wood at Lumber Camp
[*] 5 collecting Gold at the Mining Camp
[/list][/expand]
[h3]French[/h3][expand type=details]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/0a2b46af53a4af2f9d555de2a29a486b4c8c68db.jpg[/img]
[h4]Additional Starting Buildings and Units:[/h4]
[list]
[*] Mining Camp on Stone
[*] Blacksmith
[*] 3 additional Villagers
[/list]
[h4]Starting Villager Locations:[/h4]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-five-update-7-1-113/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Patch 7.1.113◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[quote][h2]New! Seasonal Event: Summer Vacation[/h2]
For our next seasonal event it’s time to grab your sunscreen and head to the beach! Beat the heat with new challenges and in-game rewards [b]from July 25th to August 21st[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/3d79efdacdeea2aa788af706e3c0baaac6bfa7cf.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/fc945da8faf8c727c82c5d5af22cb37fb9dd352b.png[/img]
[/quote]
[quote][h2]Ranked Season Updates[/h2]
[h3]Map Pool Change[/h3]
Since our Map Monsters have left for the season, they will no longer be appearing on ranked maps. The ranked map pool is otherwise unchanged. Battle your way up the ranked ladder before the season ends on [b]October 23rd at 11:59 pm PDT (Oct 24th at 06:59 UTC)[/b]!   

[h3]Ranked Rewards[/h3]
Mentioned in both our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-five-update-7-0-5861/#ongoing]Season Five release notes[/url], and [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe-iv-update-7-0-5861-now-live/#july-patch]our follow-up post[/url], progress continues to be made on changing the Ranked Rewards system. Starting with this patch, players should now see the [b][i]highest[/i][/b] rank they’ve achieved this season on their profile and on the multiplayer ranked screen.

[h3]Queue Dodging[/h3]
We’ve updated the game servers’ backend to better detect when a player purposefully disconnects from their match. The system should now apply queue dodging cooldown punishments more instantly than previous configurations. Purposefully disconnecting from a Ranked Team or Ranked 1v1 lobby or load screen, as well as any time during Ranked 1v1 matches, will now also count as a loss for the disconnecting player in addition to the cooldown punishment.  

These changes, in congruence with some of our other changes, should reduce the frequency of queue dodging. We are continuing to monitor this closely and may further tighten queue dodging punishments to be more in-line with other Age titles. 

Additionally, we remain aware queue dodging is more frequent at the high and low extremes of ELO levels and are continuing our work to address the matchmaking process for these extremes, to further reduce the frequency of queue dodging for these players.

[h3]Ranked Cheating[/h3]
In our update kicking off the start of Season 5, we mentioned our continued investigation of cheating on the Ranked ladder, especially in Teams games. [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849382676-How-do-I-report-a-player-]Thanks in part to reports sent in from players, we have taken some keys steps to reduce cheating in Ranked.[/url][/quote]

[quote][h3]Voice Chat Reporting[/h3]
See our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/16126586639380-Voice-Chat]FAQ for more information[/url] on Voice Chat features including [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408849382676-How-do-I-report-a-player-]How to Report a Player[/url]. [b]Please include as much information as possible including the date & time of your match. If you have a recording or stream of your match, please include this in your report too. Thank you.[/b][/quote]
[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

notes.title: Age of Empires IV – Update 7.0.5861 Now Live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=jRWZ20tMe_w;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote][h3]Known Issue:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Failed to Update Match Details Error In Custom Lobbies[/b]
[list][*]We are aware of a failed to update match error that sometimes occurs when selecting Empire Wars, Nomad, Crafted Maps, and some other mods. We are investigating this issue and will update this post when more information is available. [b]Clicking past the error will allow you to proceed, and the error should have no impact on gameplay.[/b][/list][/list]
Visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408424670484]Knows Issues & Solutions[/url] page to see what’s being tracked!
[/quote]
A major update for Season Five, is [u][b]LIVE[/b][/u]! In today’s update, we’re turning up the heat with Map Monsters: Summer Party Edition! Scout the land and scour the sea in search for the elusive Wild Man and mysterious Dragon Turtle in our new event! Plus, start a match off strong in [b]Empire Wars[/b] – a new, quick-to-action game mode where players start with a burgeoning empire of pre-built buildings and villagers already tasked to resources. But that’s not all: We’ve packed this update with loads of new content and features, ready for you to dive into now!

Here are a few highlights:
[list][*] Three new maps: Golden Heights, Migration, and Volcanic Island!
[*] The start of Ranked Season Five, bringing with it new rewards and an updated map pool rotation!
[*] Team Voice Chat – strategize with your friends in-match with the new team voice chat! Or use the speech-to-text feature to more easily send communications to your team!
[*] Visual upgrades, and performance-related improvements!
[*] New trade updates based directly on community feedback!
[*] New unique options for every civilization! From unique tech to unique units, we’re making design changes so that each civilization’s personality shines through!
[*] Additional support for mods that make it easier for everyone in the lobby to start the match.
[*] … and a whole lot of bug fixes & balance changes![/list]
[h2]More On What’s to Come  [/h2]
We’re excited to have you all join in the latest Season of Age of Empires IV! Season Five: Map Monsters Summer Party Edition brings a number of new features and improvements, and we’re already planning for additional patches, events and more over the next several months as part of our seasonal line-up. As well, the team is hard at work bringing Age of Empires IV to console following [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/the-console-age-is-coming-aoe/]the announcement[/url] last fall. 

Read on below for some additional details related to the next couple of months of Season Five.  

[h3]Changes to Matchmaking Present Today  [/h3]
We know you’ve already read through a lengthy set of Update Notes this week, but following yesterday’s server maintenance, you may notice some changes in Ranked matchmaking today that are aimed at getting you into a match sooner.  

These updates change the first band of our matchmaking slightly, accommodating for an initial higher-point difference in ELO between you and the person you’re ultimately matched with. This should shave off some of the initial time to matchmake for any player experiencing wait times of six minutes or less on average. We’re continuing efforts to improve matching for players toward the extreme lower and higher ends of the ELO range, but in the meantime, [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/t/matchmaking-feedback/233184]please send any feedback or issues related to these changes our way.[/url]

[h3]July Patch  [/h3]
As we mentioned earlier in the week, we’ve already got a patch in the works for late July. This patch will allow us to monitor and respond to some of the early feedback following the release of Season Five (our balance team is always eager to see what you have to say!) and also provides a chance to follow on with a few other meaningful changes, such as:  

[list]
[*] [b]Granting Ranked Rewards based on the Highest Rank you achieve during a season vs. Final Rank.[/b] We mentioned investigations were underway in our post on Monday, and we’re excited that the first wave of actions needed to complete this work were included with the server maintenance from June 14th. Ranked Rewards are tracked and granted via the server, so this was an important first move to take. Next steps include updates to the client to support this change within the UI.  
[*] [b]Updates to queue dodging.[/b] You can [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-five-update-7-0-5861/]read more about our plans in the Season Five release notes[/url], and some of these changes are currently tracking for our July update.   
[*] [b]Balancing & bug fixing[/b]. We’ll be paying close attention to what we hear from you about the Season Five build.[/list]
[h3]Late Summer Patch  [/h3]
Major updates like Season Five add a huge amount of content and changes across the board and also provide a great opportunity to keep the game fresh. Our Public Update Previews help us collect and respond to major issues beforehand, but we also expect to “fine tune ” and continually support throughout a season via smaller targeted patches. 

Still in the works, but we’re keeping eyes on a late summer patch to light up some Seasonal Events, and also to further iterate as your feedback and input shakes out. 

[hr][/hr]

Starting [b]TODAY through June 19th[/b], get [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] from [b]Steam at a 40% discount[/b]!

Your feedback in action! We listened to lots of community feedback during our last Public Update Preview (PUP) and have implemented changes to our map rotation from what was previewed in the PUP. Notably, we heard you loved the new maps Golden Heights and Volcanic Island so much, we’re bringing them directly into the pool! 

We’re also trying something a little different this season. Now through July 20th, our two Map Monsters will be visible on select maps. For the first time, our Map Monsters will also be included on Ranked maps!

notes.title: Get a Sneak Peek of Age of Empires IV Season Five with the PUP!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/a31aa7461aa6d76755a385180e180aa37fab2244.jpg[/img]

[quote][b]LIVE NOW![/b] The [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Season Five Public Update Preview (PUP) is available now through May 15th![/quote]
[expand type=showmore][h2]How to Access[/h2]

[b]To get started with the PUP build, owners on Steam can download the  [i]Age IV[/i]  PUP by following the instructions below:  [/b]

[olist]
[*] Navigate to your Steam library and right click on  Age of Empires IV .
[*] Select Properties… at the bottom of the menu .
[*] Select the BETAS tab on the left.
[*] In the Select the beta… dropdown menu, select future_live .
[*] The build will begin downloading – once complete, you are ready to play!
[olist]Please note that during the PUP, you will be required to launch the Content Editor from the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] section of your Steam Library as well. More information [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4529212287892-How-do-I-access-the-Public-Update-Preview-in-Steam-]here[/url].[/olist][/olist]
[i]Please note that replays in the PUP build are not compatible with the retail version. Players in the PUP version will only be able to match with those also on the PUP build. To revert back to retail, simply change your beta branch (step 4 above) back to “None.” [/i]

We hope you join us for this fun-filled experience, and we can’t wait to hear back from you![/expand]
[hr][/hr]

From May 4th through 15th, owners of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] on Steam will have an opportunity to dive into all the amazing content, updates and changes coming in Season Five! 

The [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Public Update Preview (PUP) presents an opportunity for our incredible players to get hands-on experience with exciting changes ahead of major updates. They also provide an opportunity to give feedback and help us prepare for upcoming major releases. PUP builds will generally contain new features, content, balance changes and bug fixes.  

[h2]A New Game Mode, Team Voice Chat, Trade Updates and More! [/h2]
Among the content highlighted in this PUP is [b]Empire Wars[/b], a new, quick-to-action game mode where players start with a burgeoning empire, ready to dive into combat or advance to the next Age! Players begin the match with a variety of pre-built buildings and villagers already tasked on resource collection.  

Not only that, but you’ll be able to try out three news maps before they officially go live, including Golden Heights, Migration, and Volcanic Island!  

The Season Five Public Update Preview will also include: 
[list][*] Team Voice Chat – strategize with your friends in-match with the new team voice chat! Or use the speech-to-text feature to more easily send communications to your team! 
[*] New trade updates based directly on community feedback! 
[*] New unique options for every civilization! From unique tech and unique units, we’re making design changes so that each civilization’s personality shines through! 
[*] Additional support for mods that make it easier for everyone in the lobby to start the match. 
[*] … and a whole lot of bug fixes & balance changes! [/list]
This build also contains a number of graphics optimizations, visual upgrades, and performance-related improvements. These kinds of system-based changes, paired with new features, can result in edge case bugs – please report any crashes or issues in the Steam Forums. One of our primary focuses this PUP is to harden our tech and ensure we’re ready to go when it’s time to officially release Season Five!   

[h2]Getting Ready for the PUP [/h2]
Alongside the PUP’s start will be Release Notes covering the available content and spectacular changes coming to [i]Age IV[/i]!

[quote]⚠️This is a preview build of an upcoming update to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Some features in this preview are not yet final. 

While all feedback will be collected, this PUP is primarily focused on gathering and acting on telemetry and reports related to stability ahead of the major Season Five update. 

Please note that Events, Rewards and certain Seasonal activities and surprises may not be present in the PUP. [/quote]
[h2]Something [i]Monstrous and Mysterious[/i] Arrives On Land & Water Soon! [/h2]
While we aren’t previewing all seasonal and event content as part of this PUP, we’re excited to let you in on some of our upcoming plans! Season Five will see the return and expansion of a concept we explore in our second season; our events will be a lot of fun and a little bit mysterious, asking you to scour the land and seas in search of these rare creatures!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/5b5c0c96c44ffbc9a916a607c389032ae80cab22.png[/img]

Map Monsters are ready to make a splash at our Pool Party event, and you’re invited to join in on the fun next month!

notes.title: Celebrate the Return of Rome By Pre-Ordering Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/1fc8b4461de5d326fec6142152a142950fe5c783.png[/img]

Where were you in 1998? Perhaps listening to Cher’s Believe, watching Titanic, playing with your Tamagotchi and relaxing on your inflatable couch? Or were you playing the [i]Age of Empires[/i] DLC [i]The Rise of Rome[/i]? This beloved evolution of the first [i]Age of Empires[/i] game has taken on a new form and joined the Definitive Edition era in the [i]Return of Rome[/i] DLC for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i].  

Yes, you read that correctly, [i]Age of Empires[/i] content available in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Bringing the civilizations and action of ancient worlds to [i]AoE II: DE[/i]. Purchasers will be able to switch to [i]Return of Rome[/i] in the game’s main screen and take on fresh challenges.  

[h2]What can you expect from this new and innovative DLC? [/h2] 
[list]
[*] 3 new campaigns created specifically for Return of Rome. Sargon of Akkad (Sumerians), Pyrrhus of Epirus (Macedonians) and Trajan (Romans). With new missions to tackle and stories told through the familiar [i]AoE II: DE[/i] style, you’ll be able to live more moments from history.  
[*] All 16 original [i]Age of Empires[/i] civilizations from the Assyrians to the Yamato. Get to grips with the civilizations that started the [i]Age of Empires[/i] journey.  
[*] One new civilization, the Lac Viet. In honor and recognition of [i]Rise of Rome[/i]’s phenomenal popularity in Vietnam, we’ve added a new civilization with [i]Return of Rome[/i]. Adding something new for established and beginner players. 
[*] New D3 Game Mode. D3 is an homage to a fan favorite rule set that is now fully integrated into the game.  This rule set reduces rush tactics and allows players to start their early game more robustly, only allowing fighting with a single unit until entering the Bronze Age, ensuring players reach later Ages for equal battles.  This rule set also bans walls and towers, making for exciting match ups later in the game. 
[*] The Roman civilization will be playable in the main [i]AoE II: DE[/i] title. If you’ve ever wondered how the Romans might fare against the Aztecs, now’s your opportunity to find out. [/list]
Catch a glimpse of what [i]Return of Rome[/i] has to offer in our teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=cLYKtoWGlsE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]How to Pre-Order[/h2]
[i]Return of Rome [/i]is available to pre-order now on Steam! This innovative DLC is available as a standalone purchase, or as a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141580/Age_of_Empires_II_Definitive_Edition__Return_of_Rome/][b]bundle[/b][/url] with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Rome is calling. It’s time to return.  
[quote]Pre-order the [i]Return of Rome[/i] today and be ready to conquer your opponents and forge a new Roman Empire on [b]May 16, 2023[/b]![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires IV – Season Four Patch 6.1.130
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/80cb2263779c967f6090ecbdda8f27f6c90522fd.jpg[/img]

Our Enchanted Grove event comes to a close with the release of Patch 6.1.130. We hope you had an [i]enchanting[/i] time in the biome but now both the biome and the Enchanted Stag have trotted off to parts unknown.

In this new patch we have listened to your feedback and reverted the resource-gathering boost which was added to the Hardest AI. Instead, we have added multiple additional new levels of AI difficulty beyond the Hardest setting making use of the boosted resource-gathering in those difficulties. We can’t wait to hear your feedback on the new AI Difficulty levels! 

There are also improvements to in-game balance, fixes to known issues, and slight tweaks to trade as our team previews some of our larger goals with that mechanic – read more below!
 
[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/] Official Forum[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/] Steam Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires] Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Thanks again to our amazing community members, all of whom have helped to make [i]Age of Empires[/i] what it is today!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[quote][b]This is just a small taste of what is coming in the latest update. For a more complete list, please visit our site and check out our blog. Happy Gaming![/b]

[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-season-four-patch-6-1-130/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/da022369a6c7a53b9fa55351ea02932a25b9dcb3.jpg[/img][/url][/quote]
[hr][/hr][code][h1]        ◆Patch 6.1.130◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h2]Build Spotlight[/h2]
[h3]Return of Hardest AI & New Difficulty Selections [/h3]
Earlier this year, we introduced a new Hardest AI that gathered resources faster and took quicker military action. You let us know that the resource-gathering boost created too much of a step-up in difficulty from Hard to Hardest and indicated that more difficulty options would be preferable. We’re pleased to provide the following updates: 

[list]
[*] We have reverted the resource-gathering boost which we had given to Hardest AI but kept other improvements made in January’s [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/age-of-empires-iv-update-52131_lunar_faire/]5.2.131 patch[/url].  
[*] We have added not 1, not 2, but 3 new AI Difficulty levels beyond the Hardest setting which have been given incremental resource-gathering boosts. The resource-gathering boosts are set at 1.2x, 1.5x and 2x the normal rate.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/6240f2049cfcba60d52695da230db881c06a212c.png[/img]

We believe these changes provide a better range of opportunities based on the amount of challenge you’re seeking. This will provide new ways of playing with and against the AI allowing for more varied battles and even more fun!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Age Insider Rewards[/h3]
We’ve unlocked several Age Insider rewards for all players starting with this update. This is to thank everyone who’s played and given feedback from before launch until now. You will find the [b]Fishing Boat Monument, Insider Portrait, Dual Fish Coat of Arms, and Fishing Net Sigil Frame[/b] within your in-game profile options. Thank you for joining us on our journey thus far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/0f0630fabc2df9fc4ffce1d4e706c523176f5ce1.jpg[/img]

🢂 [b]Having Trouble Saving Earned Rewards - Portraits, Monuments, and Coat of Arms?[/b][expand type=details]If you are receiving an error while attempting to save your new rewards, please try restarting the title or retry after several minutes.  

More information and troubleshooting is available on our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/14325904296468]Support Pages[/url].[/expand]

notes.title: LIVE—Age IV Season Four PUP Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/a31aa7461aa6d76755a385180e180aa37fab2244.jpg[/img]

[quote]⚠️ [b]The Age of Empires IV Public Update Preview (PUP) has been extended through January 26th at 10 a.m. PT (1800 UTC)![/b] Following this extension will be a small update the week of January 23rd that improves stability issues encountered in PUP.[/quote]

[b]The [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Season Four Public Update Preview (PUP) is LIVE now![/b] Through [strike]January 23rd[/strike], owners of [i]Age IV[/i] on Steam will have their first opportunity to try their hand at all the amazing content, updates, and changes coming with Season Four. Read on for more information! 

[quote]This PUP session provides a hands-on look at what’s coming to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] in our Season Four update.[/quote]

[h2]What to Expect[/h2]

Our [i]Age of Empires[/i] Public Update Previews (PUPs) present an opportunity for our incredible players to get hands-on experience with exciting changes ahead of major updates. They also provide an opportunity to give feedback and help us prepare for upcoming major releases.

Among the future content available in this PUP is a new game mode that many of you will remember from [i]Age of Empires II[/i]—Nomad! This new mode sees players begin with three randomly placed Villagers. Choose the ideal location to build your first Town Center and begin your rise through the Ages.

In addition to Nomad mode, this Season Four Public Update Preview includes:
[olist]
[*]Three New Maps (Four Lakes, Continental, Marshland)
[*]AI changes and updates, in conjunction with making the Hardest AI more of a challenge—please note that the changes to Hardest AI are not specifically related to the Season Four PUP and will be released prior to the official Season Four update as part of a minor patch
[*]Mini-map size can now be toggled between Normal, 125%, and 150%
[*]Significant improvements to the Mod Browser experience with a focus on improved discoverability
[*]Landmark balance improvements – less-used Landmarks will now be present more viable strategies or have unique features to stand out as a compelling choice
[*]…and a whole lot of bug fixes & balance changes
[/olist]
[h2]Get Ready for PUP[/h2]

Check out the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1466860/discussions/8/3766731192696900108/]Release Notes[/url] to read all about the available content and spectacular changes that are afoot for [i]Age IV[/i] in an upcoming update! 

[quote]⚠️Please note that you will need to be logged in with a Steam account that owns Age of Empires IV to view.[/quote]

[b]Finally, note that this is a preview build of an upcoming update to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. Some features in this preview are not yet final.[/b]

Please note that Events, Rewards and certain Seasonal activities and surprises may not be present in the PUP – you'll see more of what’s in store with our February release!

Don’t miss any news about this or any other Public Update Preview—sign up as an [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/insiders][i]Age[/i] Insider[/url].

[h2]How to Access the PUP[/h2]

[h3]To get started with the PUP build, owners on Steam can download the [i]Age IV[/i] PUP by following the instructions below: [/h3]
[olist]
[*] Navigate to your Steam library and right click on [b][i]Age of Empires IV[/i][/b].
[*] Select [b]Properties…[/b] at the bottom of the menu.
[*] Select the [b]BETAS[/b] tab on the left.
[*] In the [b]Select the beta…[/b] dropdown menu, select [b]future_live[/b].
[*] The build will begin downloading—once complete, you are ready to play!
[/olist]
🎞️Replays in the PUP build are not compatible with the retail version.

🫱🏻‍🫲🏽Players in the PUP version will only be able to match with those also on the PUP build.

⚠️To revert back to retail, simply change your beta branch (step 4 above) back to “None.”  

We hope you join us for this fun-filled experience, and we can't wait to hear back from you!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/d978acc305b25f90b6c00283663c0eecfc1e40f2.jpg[/img]

[quote][i][b]Editor's Note: [/b]We are aware that the Map Preference System currently does not reset votes on rotated-out maps during map rotation. For now, you can click on the "reset" button to regain all votes back to down-vote new maps.[/i][/quote]
Welcome to our first minor patch of Season Three, Patch 5.1.148! In this patch, we’re making some balance changes to Forest Ponds, Hideout, and Waterholes according to your feedback from our Season Three Public Update Preview, you’ll see some new UI improvements, and you’ll also see better general stability and performance of the game! Thia time, we’re mixing up the Season Three Map Pool, we’re giving some visual updates to the unit healthbar settings, as well as more balance work on the Malian and Ottoman Civilizations.  

In addition to all of the above, we’re also taking some time to address some of the feedback we’ve heard from you. Special thanks as well to those of you who filled out our Season Three Survey – your feedback is incredibly helpful to us, so please keep sharing your thoughts!

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-iv/] Official Forum[/url]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ PATCH 5.1.148 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]

[h2]In-Game Languages[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the Microsoft Store version of the game would not launch in Hindi and instead launched in English.[/list]
[h2]Healthbar Update[/h2]
We’ve been making an on-going effort to improve the visibility of unit selections. Since the Season Three PUP, we introduced fully-opaque white outlines around healthbars when you select your units, and this worked well to boost visibility in general. However, we’ve also heard your feedback that this change can be visually distracting in certain scenarios, so we are now iterating on this design. In Patch 5.1.148, healthbars will have a better balance with a 50% opacity outline and a black inner border for improved contrast.
[list][*]When you toggle the Healthbars Setting to “Always on”.
[list][*]All unit healthbars (owned, allied, enemy units) stay visible in 90% opacity, regardless if units are damaged.
[*]Healthbars opacity will increase to 100% when hovered or selected.
[*]All selected units will now have a white glow with 50% opacity around their healthbars as opposed to 100%. (same as command card unit cycling effects)[/list]
[*]When you toggle the Healthbars Setting to “Smart”.
[list][*]All unit healthbars (owned, allied, enemy units) stay hidden until damaged or selected.[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/f348274b1315bf3fbb71ac774a2d5316a0a952cd.png[/img]

[h2]Ranked Map Pool Rotation[/h2]
You’ve shared with us your thoughts on the Season Three Map pool, so we’re freshening up the Ranked map pools! We’ll be swapping out some maps that have been in the pool for multiple seasons with some of the brand-new maps that we introduced in the Anniversary Update. We wanted to hit the goal of providing you a good variety of map styles, while diversifying the maps between 1v1 and Team Game queues. As for voting, you’ll still have three votes in the map preference system to prioritize your favorite maps from the map selection.

[h4]1v1 Ranked Pool[/h4]

[*]French Pass
[*]King of the Hill
[*]Lipany
[*]Mediterranean
[*]Mongolian Heights
[*]Prairie
[*]The Pit
[*]Wetlands[/list]
[h4]Team Ranked Pool[/h4]
[list][*]Altai
[*]Black Forest
[*]Boulder Bay
[*]Dry Arabia
[*]Forest Ponds
[*]Hideout
[*]Hill and Dale
[*]The Pit
[*]Wetlands[/list]
[h2]Caster Mode[/h2]
[list][*]Resolved a Hotkey conflict between Observer Mode’s “Toggle fog of war” and the global command “Cycle through Villagers gathering Food”. All Cycle villager commands will now be using “Ctrl+Shift+Key” format, and reserving “Ctrl+F” for fog of war only.[/list]
