notes.title: Age of Empires IV launching October 28th Available for Pre-order Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/b6e644e0938b8f39659fca54cd26b129aa569da6.png[/img]
The global [i]Age of Empires[/i] community doesn’t have long to wait for the franchise’s next chapter! [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is launching on [b]October 28[/b] on Steam.

After [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1466860/announcements/detail/3091133357965089400]April’s Fan Preview event[/url] where we showed the game in detail for the first time, we revealed even more at the Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase about the latest chapter in the [i]Age of Empires[/i] franchise, with two new launch civilizations, a newly-revealed campaign, naval combat and the appearance of Joan of Arc.

So far, the teams at both Relic and World’s Edge have shared that players will have the choice of the English, Mongols, Chinese and Delhi Sultanate at launch, and today’s trailer revealed two more civilizations—the [b]Abbasid Dynasty[/b] and the [b]French[/b]!

The Abbasid Dynasty’s focus on technology, powered by their unique landmark—the House of Wisdom—will allow players to choose unique upgrade opportunities. Their unique units include Camel Archers and Riders.

The French were revealed alongside the 100 Years War campaign, allowing players to place themselves in the battles fought between the English and French in the 14th and 15th centuries. The French thrive in trade, with the Chamber of Commerce and Royal Institute landmarks helping strengthen a player’s late game. Royal Knights are one of the civilization’s special units with a fearsome charge ability.

Making a heroic appearance in the trailer is French heroine and icon [b]Joan of Arc[/b], who also has a starring role in the game’s key art. Teenage Joan rallied her country and led armies into battle against the occupying English. [i]Age of Empires II[/i] fans fell in love with Joan in the title’s campaign and the development teams are excited to see her return.

Back in April, we [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q1pEnd41eJA]teased the appearance of ships[/url] as the Fan Preview event ended, and today, fans saw naval combat in action. Taking the battle to the water adds a whole new dimension to player strategy and adds new meaning to “sink or swim”!

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/Age_of_Empires_IV/]Pre-Orders are Available Now![/url][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/Age_of_Empires_IV/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/34a9f84c7959f1ed0ad362721125250a1f43e4b9.png[/img] [/url]

Pre-orders are now open for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]! Head to Steam to reserve your copy. A [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/Age_of_Empires_IV/]Digital Deluxe Edition is available on Steam[/url] for fans who want even more, including a [b]digital copy of the game’s epic soundtrack as well as other exclusive in-game items[/b]. Can’t wait until October 28? Head to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com]ageofempires.com[/url] and become an [b]Age Insider[/b] to be considered for [b]beta opportunities[/b] as well as find more information on the announced civilizations and campaigns. Make history your story with [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], coming October 28 on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466860/Age_of_Empires_IV/]Steam[/url].

Have questions? Check out the [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/en-us/articles/4402078559636][i]Age of Empires IV[/i] official pre-order FAQ here[/url].

[i]—The Age of Empires Team[/i]

notes.title: The Age of Empires: Fan Preview Recap!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40285313/461192a048124d81b18c312682f27d98eab1c029.png[/img]

We’ve vacated the Town Center (for now) and our [b]Age Fan Preview[/b] broadcast has come and gone! We hope you enjoyed the show and have [i]plenty[/i] of new news to talk about and share with the community.

In case you missed some of the excitement or information in the whirlwind, here’s a quick breakdown of everything we shared today.

[h1]IV | New Civ: The Delhi Sultanate[/h1]
[previewyoutube=uHESFQ8LBfk;full][/previewyoutube]
First we revealed one of the civilizations you’ll be able to play in Age of Empires IV: the Delhi Sultanate! This first look showed off buildings, units and…elephants!

[code][list]
[*] If you’d like to learn more about what makes the Delhi Sultanate unique, you can visit our [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/]Virtual Village[/url] for a closer look.
[/list][/code]
[h1]IV | The Norman Campaign[/h1]
[previewyoutube=qojnBjUYzUU;full][/previewyoutube]
We took a deep dive into the [b]Norman Campaign[/b] coming to [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]. We previewed the documentary-style storytelling that will carry you through missions, as well as some of the gameplay captured straight from the campaign: beginning with William of Normandy’s battle for the English throne. [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] will have four playable campaigns, and we’re excited to share more as we get closer to its release.

[h1]IV | Behind-the-Scenes at Relic Entertainment[/h1]
[previewyoutube=PmwuI9vdFi8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is being developed by [b]Relic Entertainment[/b], who offered us a behind-the-scenes look at their Vancouver studio and work on the game. Their history with real time strategy games, their passionate team, and their love for the franchise shone through in our chats with them, and we hope you enjoyed getting to know the people behind the project!

[h1]IV | New Civ: The Chinese[/h1]
[previewyoutube=hvuOQ84VrRw;full][/previewyoutube]
Our trip to Vancouver to visit Relic was followed by another special civilization reveal for [i]Age of Empires IV[/i]: [b]the Chinese![/b] Their reveal video gave us a taste for their units, unique buildings, and even the first notes of their musical theme.

[code][list]
[*] Learn more about the Chinese civilization in the [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/]Virtual Village[/url].
[/list][/code]
[h1]II | New Expansion: The Dawn of the Dukes[/h1]
[previewyoutube=ATBsKnkabkk;full][/previewyoutube]
As Fan Preview is a celebration of ALL things [i]Age of Empires[/i], we also wanted to feature our [i]Definitive Editions[/i]. We’ve been so thrilled to remaster these classic titles for new and old players alike, and to continue evolving them alongside the community’s feedback!

Today we announced some big additions coming to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition:[/i]
[list]
[*] The second official DLC—[b]Dawn of the Dukes[/b]—is coming with an Eastern European setting!
[*] Some of our existing campaigns will be playable in two player [b]co-op[/b], with more information about the feature coming soon!
[/list]
[h1]III | New Civ: The United States[/h1]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/aoe3de-ushc-dc.jpg[/img]

[i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] is getting more content too! On April 13, you'll be able to experience the [b]United States[/b] civilization.
[list]
[*] A new civilization, new customizable home city, distinct units, and unique mechanics are on the horizon!
[*] You’ll be able to earn the United States civ for FREE by completing the [b]Fifty States Challenge[/b], or by purchasing and unlocking it immediately via Steam or the Microsoft Store.
[*] We’ll also be expanding the civ roster in the future as we head to [b]Africa[/b]. More information to come!
[/list]
[h1]♥ | A Community Tribute[/h1]
[previewyoutube=0d_SwlRazco;full][/previewyoutube]
One of the best things about [i]Age of Empires[/i] is the vibrant, creative, welcoming community. A celebration of the franchise wouldn’t be complete without all of YOU, so the Relic and World’s Edge Community Teams got together to pay tribute to you and your love of the games. It’s been a fantastic journey with you all so far, and we can’t wait to see you in [i]Age of Empires IV[/i].

[h1]IV | Age of Empires IV Gameplay: An Exclusive Look![/h1]
[previewyoutube=0EU0AHLkHFA;full][/previewyoutube]
You’ve been asking to see more of [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], so we pulled a little something together! This epic look at the gameplay of [i]Age IV[/i] showcases all of our revealed civilizations as they build and battle across the Ages. There are so many great moments, and we’re excited to hear what stands out to you!

[h1]IV | A Final Look...[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Q1pEnd41eJA;full][/previewyoutube]
Just when you thought we were done, our host hinted at one final look at the game...

[h1]...But Wait, There's More![/h1]
And with that, our show was done! A big thank you to our host [b]Zak (AKA ZeroEmpires)[/b] and to the entire team who worked so hard to put the show together.

But this is just the beginning! Fan Preview isn’t finished just yet; there are a few more activities for you to enjoy over the next week:

[code][list]
[*] You can head to our [url=https://fanpreview.ageofempires.com/][b]Virtual Village[/b][/url] to catch more exclusive content, learn more about the [i]Age of Empires IV[/i] civilizations we've revealed thus far, and take part in some activities built exclusively for this celebration.
[*] An [b][i]Age of Empires IV[/i] Closed Beta[/b] is on the horizon! If you want a chance to take part, you’ll need to be an [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/insiders][b][i]Age of Empires[/i] Insider[/b][/url]. Go sign up if you haven’t already; we’ll have more to share about the Beta in the near future, so stay tuned to our social channels and website.
[*] There’s also an opportunity to [b]win a one-of-a-kind, Age of Empires-branded, Dell Alienware Aurora R11 Desktop.[/b] [b][url=http://ageofempiressweepstakes.com/]Enter for a chance to win![/url][/b]
[/list][/code]
[i]Age of Empires IV[/i] is coming this [b]Fall 2021[/b] as our [i]Definitive Editions[/i] continue to evolve month after month. There’s never been a better time to be an [i]Age of Empires[/i] fan, and we’re excited for what comes next.

So, to everyone joining us, whether new or for the twentieth (or more) years: [b]WO-LO-LO![/b]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team
